技術要點：酵素活性不穩定，需新鮮抹片（避免 EDTA 久置）並附正常對照；判讀只計成熟嗜中性球。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把紅色對比染色的細胞核誤認為陽性；陽性是藍色（此法）胞質沉澱，無藍色顆粒者為 0 分，且只能評分成熟嗜中性球。

quiz.q: CML 慢性期與 leukemoid reaction 的 LAP score 各為高或低？
quiz.a: CML 低；leukemoid reaction 高

62775.recognize_zh: 胸水抹片中有胞質豐富、淡染的大型組織球，胞質內包著數個完整的小淋巴球（emperipolesis），加上 CT 可見肋膜積液，指向結外 Rosai-Dorfman 病。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm
Intact small lymphocytes engulfed within histiocyte cytoplasm (emperipolesis)
Histiocyte nuclei round to oval, vesicular, with small nucleoli and no significant atypia
Background of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells, and mesothelial/histiocytic cells
Chest CT (panel A) shows pleural effusion with mediastinal soft tissue density
62775.describe_en: Chest CT shows pleural effusion with mediastinal soft tissue prominence. Cytospin preparation of the pleural fluid shows a mixed population of small lymphocytes, plasma cells, and numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei. Several histiocytes contain multiple intact lymphocytes within their cytoplasm (emperipolesis), without significant nuclear atypia. Findings are suggestive of extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease involving the pleura; confirmation with S100 and CD68/CD163 immunostaining (S100-positive, CD1a-negative) is recommended.

ddx.dx: Reactive macrophages with phagocytosis in effusion
ddx.vs: Ordinary macrophages ingest degenerated or apoptotic debris, whereas RDD histiocytes contain intact, viable lymphocytes and are S100-positive.
HLH macrophages destroy engulfed erythrocytes and nucleated cells in a clinical setting of cytopenias and hyperferritinemia, and are S100-negative.
LCH cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei without emperipolesis and are CD1a- and langerin-positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or mesothelioma in effusion
ddx.vs: Malignant epithelial cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear atypia and are keratin-positive rather than containing intact lymphocytes.

62711.recognize_zh: 原始細胞閘門內的 CD15 對 CD10 流式圖：大部分原始細胞（紅色）CD15 陰性、CD10 陰性到弱陽性並有部分延伸至陽性；另有一群被框起（O 閘門，橘色）的原始細胞 CD15 陽性、CD10 表現不一，提示存在帶骨髓系分化標記的次族群。
features: Gated on blasts; CD15-PB (x-axis) versus CD10-APC700 (y-axis)
Main blast population (red) CD15 negative with CD10 negative to dim and a partial tail of CD10-positive events up to about 10^4
Discrete gated subset 'O' (orange) with CD15 expression (about 2x10^3 to 3x10^4)
CD15-positive subset shows variable CD10 from negative to about 10^4
No CD10-bright uniform population
62711.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis gated on blasts displays CD15 versus CD10. The majority of blasts are CD15 negative with CD10 negative to dim and a partial tail of CD10-positive events. A distinct gated subset (O, orange) expresses CD15 with variable CD10. Partial CD10 expression can contribute to B-lineage assignment in combination with strong CD19 and CD79a/cCD22, whereas CD15 is a myeloid-associated but not lineage-defining marker. These findings support a heterogeneous blast population in keeping with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid.

ddx.vs: Typically CD10 negative with CD15 and CD65 co-expression on CD19-positive blasts but lacks MPO expression, and must be classified by the defining KMT2A rearrangement.
CD15 is acquired along granulocytic maturation with increasing side scatter, and blasts lack B-lineage markers such as strong CD19 with CD79a/CD10.

ddx.dx: Normal maturing granulocytes contaminating the gate
ddx.vs: Mature granulocytes are CD15 bright with high side scatter and CD10 bright on segmented neutrophils, not low-scatter blasts.

62583.recognize_zh: CD10 染色中，密集的中等大小淋巴瘤細胞大多為陰性，只有散在細胞呈強陽性；這提醒你高分級濾泡性淋巴瘤（grade 3）可失去 CD10 表現，不能因 CD10 陰性就排除 FL。
features: Dense population of medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, largely CD10-negative
Scattered individual cells with strong membranous/cytoplasmic CD10 staining, more numerous at the right of the field
Weak, granular background staining between cells without a crisp membranous pattern in the tumor cells
No discrete CD10-positive follicle-center pattern delineated in this field
62583.describe_en: CD10 immunohistochemistry shows a sheet of medium-sized lymphoid cells that are predominantly negative, with only faint background staining. Scattered cells, clustered toward one side of the field, show strong CD10 positivity; these may represent residual germinal-center cells or granulocytes and do not account for the bulk of the infiltrate. The neoplastic population therefore appears largely CD10-negative in this field. Loss or reduction of CD10 is recognized in grade 3 follicular lymphoma, particularly grade 3B, and interpretation should be integrated with BCL6, BCL2 and the H&E findings.

ddx.vs: MZL is also CD10-negative but lacks BCL6 expression and centroblast-rich follicular nodules, and shows monocytoid morphology.
Reactive germinal centers are uniformly CD10-positive and sharply confined to follicles with BCL2-negative germinal centers.
Low-grade FL is typically diffusely CD10-positive within neoplastic follicles, whereas CD10 loss favors higher grade.

62519.recognize_zh: 中倍下下方為淡染顆粒狀的壞死區，外圍由柵欄狀排列的上皮樣組織球包圍，再外層是含淋巴球與漿細胞的纖維化帶；這種分層結構就是貓抓病常見的壞死性（化膿性）肉芽腫。
features: Central zone of pale granular necrosis with a cleft artifact
Rim of palisading epithelioid histiocytes with elongated nuclei oriented perpendicular to the necrosis
Outer fibrous band with lymphocytes and plasma cells
Scattered nuclear debris within necrosis; no multinucleated giant cells evident in this field
62519.describe_en: Intermediate-power H&E of lymph node shows a necrotizing granuloma composed of a central zone of pale, granular necrotic debris with scattered nuclear dust, surrounded by a rim of palisading epithelioid histiocytes. External to the histiocytic layer there is a fibrous band containing lymphocytes and plasma cells. No atypical cells or organisms are seen on H&E. Findings are consistent with necrotizing granulomatous lymphadenitis; in the appropriate clinical setting this pattern is characteristic of cat scratch disease, with confirmation by Warthin-Starry/Steiner stain, serology or PCR for Bartonella henselae.

ddx.vs: TB shows caseous necrosis with Langhans giant cells and acid-fast bacilli, typically lacking neutrophil-rich stellate abscesses.
These produce morphologically similar suppurative granulomas and require exposure history, culture or serology.
Kikuchi lacks palisading granulomas and neutrophils and shows crescentic histiocytes around karyorrhectic debris.

ddx.dx: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis or fungal infection
ddx.vs: Fungal organisms are shown by GMS/PAS, and GPA shows vasculitis with ANCA positivity.

exam.answer_en: Cat scratch disease — necrotizing (suppurative) granuloma with palisading epithelioid histiocytes around central necrosis
pearls_zh: 考法：指著壞死區外圍垂直排列的上皮樣組織球，問這是什麼結構（palisading granuloma）與最可能病原（Bartonella henselae）。
病原確認：Warthin-Starry 等銀染可見細小桿菌聚集於壞死邊緣或血管壁；臨床常以 Bartonella 血清抗體或 PCR 證實。
病程演變：早期為濾泡增生與 monocytoid B 細胞增生，之後出現含中性球的星狀微膿瘍，最後形成壞死性肉芽腫。
臨床：接觸貓（多為幼貓）抓傷後數週出現局部淋巴結腫大，多可自限；免疫低下者可發生 bacillary angiomatosis。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為結核的乾酪性肉芽腫：結核壞死均質無中性球、常有 Langhans 巨細胞，需抗酸染色；貓抓病壞死含中性球與核碎片，呈星狀化膿性。

quiz.q: 圖中壞死區周圍垂直排列的細胞是什麼？此病的病原體為何？
quiz.a: 柵欄狀上皮樣組織球（palisading epithelioid histiocytes）；Bartonella henselae

62455.recognize_zh: 上方淋巴球核輪廓不規則、染色質緻密，細胞質少並有突出的藍色細胞質尾；下方淋巴球核圓、染色質細緻略呈褶紋；兩者皆為高核質比的小到中型 T 淋巴球樣細胞，腦回狀核不明顯，中央另見一團折光性碎屑（artifact）。
features: Two small to medium lymphoid cells with high N:C ratios
Upper cell: irregular, slightly indented nuclear outline with dense chromatin and a basophilic cytoplasmic tail
Lower cell: round nucleus with finely clumped chromatin showing a faint folded texture, scant cytoplasm
No distinct nucleoli; no definite deeply cerebriform nuclei
Central refractile, yellowish irregular debris (artifact); red cells unremarkable with scattered platelets
62455.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and dense chromatin, one with an irregular, indented nuclear contour and a cytoplasmic tail and the other with a round nucleus showing a faint folded chromatin texture. No nucleoli are apparent. A refractile fragment of debris is present in the center of the field as an artifact. The atypical nuclear contours are suggestive but not diagnostic of Sezary cells; in the context of mycosis fungoides, blood involvement should be confirmed by flow cytometry and clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Normal lymphocytes have smooth round nuclei, and distinction from small Sezary cells depends on flow cytometry showing an expanded CD4+ CD7-/CD26- population.
T-PLL cells usually have a visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs with very high lymphocyte counts and TCL1A rearrangement.
ATLL cells show multilobated flower-shaped nuclei and are HTLV-1 and CD25 positive.

62391.recognize_zh: 高倍下是生發中心內混合的細胞群：核大、染色質開放並有周邊核仁的中心母細胞（centroblast）、核裂狀的中心細胞、少數核仁明顯的免疫母細胞、小淋巴球，以及細胞質嗜伊紅、核偏位的漿細胞與吞噬碎屑的巨噬細胞；細胞組成多樣說明這是反應性生發中心。
features: Polymorphous germinal center population with mixed cell sizes
Centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and peripheral nucleoli
Centrocytes with irregular cleaved nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Scattered immunoblasts with single central nucleoli
Admixed plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm, plus small lymphocytes
Tingible-body macrophages with pale cytoplasm and apoptotic debris
62391.describe_en: High-power view of a germinal center shows a polymorphous population of centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and peripheral nucleoli, centrocytes with cleaved nuclei, and scattered immunoblasts. Plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and small lymphocytes are admixed, together with tingible-body macrophages containing apoptotic debris. There are no sheets of monotonous atypical cells. The findings represent a reactive germinal center with plasmacytosis, which in the appropriate immunohistochemical context may be seen in IgG4-related lymphadenopathy.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles contain monotonous centroblasts without tingible-body macrophages or polarization and are BCL2-positive with a lower Ki-67 than reactive centers.
DLBCL consists of sheets of large atypical cells effacing architecture rather than a mixed population confined to follicles.
CHL shows diagnostic Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed interfollicular background and is CD30+/CD15+.

62135.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一大片黏聚成團的單一形態腫瘤細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、有小核仁，胞質淡藍並含多個清楚小空泡（箭頭），提示轉移性肺泡型橫紋肌肉瘤造成的骨髓侵犯（myelophthisis）。
features: Large cohesive sheet of monotonous medium-sized cells with nuclear molding
Round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with multiple small clear punched-out vacuoles
Poorly defined cell borders with a syncytial appearance
Normal hematopoietic elements not seen within the cluster
62135.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large cohesive aggregate of monotonous medium-sized cells replacing the field. The cells have round nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, and moderate amounts of pale basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple small clear vacuoles. The cohesive syncytial arrangement with nuclear molding favors a metastatic non-hematopoietic small round cell tumor over leukemia. In this clinical context, findings are consistent with marrow infiltration by alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma; confirmation requires biopsy with desmin/myogenin immunostains and FOXO1 rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells also have cytoplasmic vacuoles but are dispersed singly with deep blue cytoplasm and are CD20/CD10 positive with MYC rearrangement.
Lymphoblasts are discohesive with scant cytoplasm and express TdT, unlike cohesive desmin/myogenin-positive rhabdomyosarcoma cells.
Ewing cells may contain glycogen vacuoles but show membranous CD99 and NKX2.2 with EWSR1 rearrangement and lack myogenin.
Neuroblastoma clusters form Homer Wright rosettes with fibrillary neuropil and are PHOX2B positive.

62071.recognize_zh: 抹片中一片黏合成片、呈鞘狀排列的細胞，有豐富、均質淡藍灰色的細胞質與圓至橢圓形核、染色質均勻無明顯核仁，細胞邊界不清，表面黏附許多血小板，符合抽血時帶入的內皮細胞，而非腫瘤細胞。
features: Cohesive sheet of cells with a sheath-like arrangement and indistinct cell borders
Abundant homogeneous pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Round to oval, eccentric nuclei with evenly condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Minimal nuclear size variation; no mitoses, molding, or atypia
Numerous platelets adherent to the cell cluster; red cells in background
62071.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a cohesive, sheet-like cluster of cells with indistinct borders and abundant homogeneous pale blue-gray cytoplasm. The nuclei are round to oval, somewhat eccentric, and uniform, with evenly condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, without pleomorphism, molding, or mitotic figures. Numerous platelets are adherent to the cluster. Findings are consistent with endothelial cells introduced during venipuncture, a benign finding that should not be mistaken for circulating tumor cells.

ddx.dx: Circulating carcinoma or other metastatic tumor cells
ddx.vs: Tumor clusters show nuclear pleomorphism, high N:C ratio, prominent nucleoli, and nuclear molding, unlike these bland uniform nuclei with abundant cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytes have a single large lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm, whereas this is a sheet of multiple uniform separate nuclei.
Squamous cells are large, flat, polygonal with small pyknotic nuclei and well-defined borders, not a syncytial sheet with oval nuclei.

62007.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中黑色箭頭指一顆三核的紅血球系前驅細胞（多核，dyserythropoiesis），黃色箭頭為顆粒稀少、核分葉異常的中性球，洋紅箭頭為細胞質含粗顆粒的晚期紅血球母細胞；同一視野內紅血球系與顆粒球系皆有發育不良，符合 MDS 多系發育不良。
features: Multinucleated (trinucleate) erythroid precursor with basophilic cytoplasm (black arrow)
Hypogranular neutrophil with abnormally segmented, clumped nucleus (yellow arrow)
Late erythroid precursor with irregular nucleus and coarse cytoplasmic granules nearby (magenta arrow)
Erythroid precursors with open, megaloblastoid chromatin
Hypogranular myelocytes/metamyelocytes; background red cells with drying artifact
62007.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows dysplastic changes in more than one lineage. There is a trinucleate erythroid precursor (black arrow) and erythroid precursors with megaloblastoid open chromatin; a late erythroid precursor shows nuclear irregularity with coarse cytoplasmic granules (magenta arrow). A neutrophil shows hypogranular cytoplasm with abnormal nuclear segmentation (yellow arrow), and other maturing granulocytes are hypogranular. Blasts are not increased in this field. The findings are consistent with multilineage dysplasia, in keeping with MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: B12/folate deficiency causes megaloblastoid erythroids and multinucleation but with giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils rather than hypogranular hyposegmented forms, and it corrects with replacement.
CDA has isolated erythroid dysplasia (e.g., binucleate forms, internuclear bridges) from youth without granulocytic dysplasia or ring sideroblasts.
These can mimic MDS including ring sideroblasts; exposure history, copper levels and clonal studies discriminate.

exam.answer_en: MDS with multilineage dysplasia — trinucleate erythroid precursor and hypogranular, abnormally segmented neutrophils
pearls_zh: 考法：考官依箭頭逐一問：黑箭頭三核紅系前驅細胞（dyserythropoiesis）、黃箭頭顆粒稀少且分葉異常的中性球（dysgranulopoiesis）。
發育不良需該系 ≥10% 細胞才計入；骨髓抹片應計數至少 500 顆有核細胞評估 blast 比例。
必做鐵染色找 ring sideroblasts，並做染色體與 NGS（如 SF3B1、TP53）以分類與評估預後。
需先排除 B12/葉酸缺乏、銅缺乏、酒精、藥物等可逆性發育不良。
WHO 5th 不再以單系/多系發育不良作為主要分型依據；ICC 2022 仍保留 MDS, NOS with multilineage dysplasia。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與巨母紅血球性貧血混淆；後者有巨大後髓細胞與過度分葉中性球、補充 B12/葉酸可恢復，本圖為顆粒減少且分葉異常的中性球。

quiz.q: 黑色箭頭所指細胞的異常為何？代表哪一系發育不良？
quiz.a: 多核（三核）紅系前驅細胞；dyserythropoiesis

61943.recognize_zh: 高倍下是多形性族群：大量小淋巴球之間夾雜許多具泡狀核與明顯核仁的大型免疫母細胞（immunoblast），其中還有類似Reed-Sternberg的多核大細胞，是EBV再活化的典型細胞譜系。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate with a continuum from small lymphocytes to large immunoblasts
Numerous large cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli (immunoblasts)
Occasional large bi/multilobated cell resembling a Reed-Sternberg-like cell
Scattered plasmacytoid cells and small mature lymphocytes in the background
Pink histiocytic/epithelioid cytoplasm and delicate stroma between cells
61943.describe_en: High-power view shows a polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells and numerous large immunoblasts with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli. Occasional large multilobated Reed-Sternberg-like cells are present. The cells form a spectrum of sizes rather than a monotonous population, and histiocytes are interspersed. Findings are consistent with an EBV-driven reactive immunoblastic proliferation; EBER in situ hybridization and immunostains for CD20, CD3, CD30 and CD15 help exclude lymphoma.

ddx.vs: In cHL the RS cells are CD15+/CD30+ with weak PAX5 and loss of CD20/CD45 in an effaced node, whereas EBV-reactivation immunoblasts are CD20+ or CD3+, CD45+ and CD15- within a continuous size spectrum.
DLBCL shows sheets of monotonous large cells rather than scattered immunoblasts admixed with abundant small lymphocytes and plasma cells.
THRLBCL has few scattered large B cells in a background of T cells and histiocytes without small B cells, whereas reactive EBV proliferations contain a continuum of B-cell sizes and plasma cells.

61815.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的顆粒（particle）中央有一顆大型巨核細胞，細胞內含多個彼此分離的圓形核，周圍夾雜造血細胞與脂肪空泡，提示多核、核葉分離的發育不良巨核細胞。
features: Large megakaryocyte within a marrow particle containing multiple separate round nuclei
Abundant grey-blue finely granular megakaryocyte cytoplasm
Surrounding cellular particle with myeloid and erythroid precursors, partly crushed
Numerous fat vacuoles and streaming red cells around the particle
Background with scattered platelets
61815.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle containing a large megakaryocyte with multiple discrete, widely separated round nuclei rather than a single lobulated nucleus, surrounded by granulocytic and erythroid precursors and fat vacuoles. Part of the particle is crushed, limiting assessment of individual precursor cells. Megakaryocytes with multiple separated nuclei are a recognized dysplastic form. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia in a myelodysplastic/myeloid neoplasm associated with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts have multiple uniform round nuclei with a single nucleolus each, pink granular cytoplasm and no platelet budding.
Normal megakaryocytes have connected nuclear lobes forming a single polylobated nucleus without discrete separate nuclei.
Tumor clusters show cohesive cells with distinct cell borders rather than a single cell with shared cytoplasm.

61751.recognize_zh: 免疫染色顯示一團密集、呈強膜狀陽性的小型淋巴球結節，周圍有陽性細胞向外散布到陰性的梭形基質區；這種以結節擴張為主的 B 細胞染色型態可對應脾邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Dense nodular aggregate of small lymphoid cells with strong membranous staining
Positive cells spill out from the nodule as single cells into the surrounding tissue
Surrounding stroma composed of negative spindled/elongated cells
Uniform small cell size of the positive population
Specific antibody not labeled in the image; pattern suggests a pan-B-cell marker
61751.describe_en: Immunohistochemistry (antibody not specified; staining pattern of a pan-B-cell marker such as CD20) highlights a dense nodular aggregate of small lymphoid cells with strong membranous positivity. Positive cells also extend individually into the surrounding negative stroma. Because the antibody is not identified and only one field is shown, the pattern supports a B-cell nodular infiltrate but is not by itself specific. In the clinical and splenic context, findings are consistent with involvement by splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive white pulp retains germinal centers, IgD-positive mantle zones, and polytypic light chains, while SMZL shows monotypic B cells replacing the follicle with a marginal zone pattern.
CLL/SLL cells coexpress CD5 and CD23 with LEF1, whereas SMZL is typically CD5-negative and CD23-negative.
MCL is CD5-positive with nuclear cyclin D1 and SOX11, which SMZL lacks.
FL nodules are CD10/BCL6-positive with BCL2-positive germinal centers, whereas SMZL is CD10-negative.

61687.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（CD3 對 CD7），非形態影像；主要藍色族群 CD3 陽性且 CD7 強表現（約 10^2），下方的洋紅色 CD3 陽性族群 CD7 較弱，而左上方綠色 CD3 陰性、CD7 陽性的是 NK 細胞。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD3-PC5.5 (x-axis) versus CD7-APC700 (y-axis), gate labeled [AZ]
Dominant blue CD3-positive population with bright CD7 (up to about 10^2) forming a diagonal cluster
Magenta and red CD3-positive events with dim to negative CD7 below the main cluster
Green CD3-negative, CD7-positive population at upper left, consistent with NK cells
Green/magenta CD3-negative, CD7-negative population near the origin
61687.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot displays CD3 versus CD7 expression within the gated population. The dominant population (blue) co-expresses CD3 and bright CD7, while a smaller CD3-positive population with dim to absent CD7 (magenta/red) lies beneath it. CD3-negative, CD7-positive events consistent with NK cells and a double-negative population are also present. An expanded CD3-positive population with bright CD7 is characteristic of T-prolymphocytic leukemia and argues against Sezary syndrome or ATLL, which typically show CD7 loss.

61623.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見各階段的顆粒球（骨髓細胞、帶狀核、分葉核）與數個紅血球母細胞，另有一個大型、胞質深藍的早期紅血球前驅細胞；形態上僅見輕微異常，環狀鐵粒母細胞需另以鐵染色確認。
features: Mixed marrow population with maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands)
Erythroid precursors including a large basophilic pronormoblast-like cell with deeply blue cytoplasm
Polychromatophilic and orthochromatic normoblasts, some with irregular cytoplasmic outlines
No clear megaloblastoid change, nuclear budding, or multinucleation convincingly seen
Blasts not increased; ring sideroblasts not assessable on Wright stain
61623.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed population of maturing granulocytic cells, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, and band forms, together with erythroid precursors ranging from a large basophilic pronormoblast-like cell to polychromatophilic and orthochromatic normoblasts. Dysplastic changes are subtle in this field, and blasts are not increased. Ring sideroblasts cannot be identified on a Romanowsky stain; an iron stain and SF3B1 mutation analysis are required to support MDS with ring sideroblasts and single-lineage (erythroid) dysplasia.

ddx.vs: A normal marrow may look identical on Wright stain; the diagnosis of MDS-RS rests on ring sideroblast quantitation and clonal genetics.
Requires dysplasia in ≥10% of cells in at least two lineages (e.g., hypogranular neutrophils, micromegakaryocytes), not evident here.
Megaloblastic anemia shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open-chromatin erythroblasts and giant bands/metamyelocytes.

61495.recognize_zh: 高倍視野中同時可見 4–5 顆大型巨核細胞，細胞質豐富、核分葉且形態大致正常，周圍為紅血球系與顆粒球系前驅細胞，呈現 ITP 骨髓常見的巨核細胞增加。
features: Several (4-5) large megakaryocytes in a single high-power field, indicating increased megakaryocyte number
Megakaryocytes have abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei without severe atypia
Occasional megakaryocytes with less lobulated or more condensed nuclei, possibly immature forms
Background of maturing erythroid precursors (small round dark nuclei) and granulocytic cells
Loose, somewhat disrupted stroma with processing artifact; focus is limited at the edges
61495.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows increased megakaryocytes, with four to five large forms present in one field. They have abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei without significant dysplastic features, and are admixed with maturing erythroid and granulocytic precursors. No fibrosis or abnormal infiltrate is appreciated, although section artifact and focus limit fine detail. In a thrombocytopenic patient, findings are consistent with increased marrow megakaryopoiesis secondary to peripheral platelet destruction, as in immune thrombocytopenia (ITP).

ddx.vs: MPN megakaryocytes form clusters and show hyperlobated (ET) or bulbous, hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei (PMF) with reticulin fibrosis, and platelet counts are typically high.
Dysplastic megakaryocytes are micromegakaryocytes or hypolobated/separated-lobe forms, unlike the well-lobulated forms here.
Marrow megakaryocytes may also be increased; the peripheral smear (schistocytes) and coagulation or ADAMTS13 studies separate them, not marrow morphology.

61367.recognize_zh: 左側可見成片、大小一致的早期紅血球前驅細胞，核圓、染色質細緻並有核仁；右側則是增加的顆粒球系與大量帶鮮紅顆粒的嗜酸性球，這種早期紅系聚集合併嗜酸性球增多，是 PCM1::JAK2 骨髓/淋巴腫瘤的典型骨髓樣貌。
features: Large sheet-like clusters of immature erythroid precursors with round nuclei, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Left-shifted erythroid islands displacing normal marrow elements
Increased granulopoiesis with numerous eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors containing bright red granules
Scattered erythroid normoblasts with dense nuclei among myeloid cells
Paratrabecular bone at top edge; interstitial hemorrhage/erythrocytes in the background
61367.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow containing large sheets of immature erythroid precursors with round nuclei, fine chromatin and nucleoli, forming expanded left-shifted erythroid islands. The adjacent marrow shows increased granulopoiesis with conspicuous eosinophilia. The combination of clustered early erythroid precursors, eosinophilia and myeloid hyperplasia is characteristic of myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PCM1::JAK2, which requires confirmation by karyotype t(8;9)(p22;p24) or FISH/RT-PCR; immunostains (E-cadherin, CD71, CD34) help separate early erythroid cells from blasts.

ddx.vs: Requires more than 30% pronormoblasts among nucleated cells, typically with TP53 mutation and complex karyotype, and lacks the eosinophilia with JAK2 rearrangement.
Cohesive sheets of tumor cells could mimic erythroid clusters, but are cytokeratin positive and lack erythroid markers such as CD71 and glycophorin.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRA or FGFR1 rearrangement
ddx.vs: Shares eosinophilia but usually lacks prominent early erythroid sheets; distinguished by FISH for PDGFRA or FGFR1.
Shows myeloid hyperplasia with small hypolobated megakaryocytes and basophilia, and is confirmed by BCR::ABL1 rather than JAK2 rearrangement.

61303.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有數個大型巨噬細胞，細胞質豐富、充滿大小不一的透明空泡（泡沫狀），多個造血細胞（包括嗜中性球與幼稚細胞）位於其細胞質範圍內，提示噬血現象；但抹片品質與重疊使吞噬是否確實位於胞內較難完全確認。
features: Large macrophages with abundant pale blue, finely vacuolated (foamy) cytoplasm
Multiple hematopoietic cells, including segmented neutrophils and immature myeloid cells, within the macrophage cytoplasm
Macrophage nuclei round to oval with open chromatin
Poorly spread red cells appearing as grey ghosts and smear streak artifacts
Scattered intact myeloid and erythroid precursors in the background
61303.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several large macrophages with abundant foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm. Multiple hematopoietic cells, including neutrophils and immature myeloid precursors, are situated within the macrophage cytoplasm, consistent with phagocytosis of hematopoietic elements. Preparation quality is suboptimal with poorly spread red cells and streak artifact, and overlap cannot be fully excluded for every cell. Findings are suggestive of hemophagocytosis; correlation with clinical and laboratory HLH criteria (ferritin, soluble CD25, cytopenias, fever, splenomegaly) is recommended.

ddx.dx: Cells overlying macrophages on a thick smear
ddx.vs: Overlapping cells lie in a different plane and lack a surrounding clear phagocytic vacuole, whereas engulfed cells are enclosed within cytoplasm.
Gaucher cells have crumpled tissue-paper cytoplasm without ingested intact hematopoietic cells.
These contain blue-green granules or lipid vacuoles but no engulfed erythrocytes, platelets, or leukocytes.

61239.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆大細胞，核分成四個像苜蓿葉般的圓形核葉，每葉各含一個核仁，細胞質淡而豐富，這種多核 Reed-Sternberg 細胞需與同樣大且多葉的巨核細胞區分。
features: Large cell with a multilobated/multinucleated nucleus forming a cloverleaf of four rounded lobes
Each lobe contains a distinct nucleolus within finely granular chromatin
Abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with ill-defined borders and scattered fine granules
Background of mixed marrow cells: myelocytes, segmented neutrophils, lymphocytes, plasma cells and an eosinophil
Distorted, crowded red cells in a thick area of the smear
61239.describe_en: Wright-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large cell with a cloverleaf-shaped, multilobated nucleus composed of discrete rounded lobes, each with a distinct nucleolus, and abundant pale cytoplasm. The background contains a mixture of maturing granulocytes, lymphocytes, plasma cells and an eosinophil. Although megakaryocytes can have a similar lobated appearance, the discrete lobes with individual nucleoli favor a multinucleate Reed-Sternberg cell. Findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by classical Hodgkin lymphoma, which should be confirmed on trephine biopsy with CD30 and CD15 immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single interconnected lobulated nucleus with condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and granular pink cytoplasm with platelet budding, and are CD61/CD42b positive.
Osteoclasts contain numerous small, uniform, separate nuclei within very large granular cytoplasm rather than a few large nucleolated lobes.

ddx.dx: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma or anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show floral/horseshoe nuclei in many cells with CD3/CD25 or CD30/ALK phenotype, not rare scattered cells in a reactive background.

61175.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中骨小樑之間的骨髓腔幾乎完全被淡紫色的腫瘤細胞與纖維化間質取代，看不到脂肪與正常造血細胞，這種瀰漫性取代型態提示轉移性腫瘤，配合病史為第四期神經母細胞瘤（neuroblastoma）骨髓轉移。
features: Near-complete replacement of intertrabecular marrow spaces by a tumor infiltrate at low power
Loss of normal fat and trilineage hematopoiesis; only small residual islands of hematopoietic cells and hemorrhage
Tumor cells arranged in sheets and vague nests with ovoid to spindled nuclei and pale cytoplasm
Associated fibrillary/fibrotic stroma separating tumor cell groups
Bony trabeculae intact without obvious osteolytic or new bone formation in this field
Cytologic detail (rosettes, neuropil) not resolvable at this magnification
61175.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows extensive replacement of the intertrabecular marrow spaces by a tumor infiltrate, with loss of normal fat and hematopoietic elements except for small residual foci. The tumor cells grow in sheets and vague nests within a fibrillary to fibrotic stroma. Cytologic details such as rosettes or neuropil cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by metastatic tumor; in the clinical setting this represents metastatic neuroblastoma, which should be confirmed with higher-power evaluation and PHOX2B/synaptophysin immunostains.

ddx.vs: Primary myelofibrosis shows atypical clustered megakaryocytes and streaming hematopoietic cells in fibrosis, without cohesive nests of non-hematopoietic tumor cells.

ddx.dx: Other metastatic small round cell tumor (Ewing sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Low-power pattern is similar; distinction requires immunostains (CD99/NKX2.2 for Ewing, desmin/myogenin for rhabdomyosarcoma, PHOX2B for neuroblastoma).
ALL produces a packed diffuse marrow of discohesive blasts without nesting or stromal fibrosis and is TdT/CD34 positive.
Carcinoma shows glandular or cohesive nests with desmoplasia, usually in adults, and is cytokeratin positive.

61111.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片可見巨大前紅血球（giant pronormoblasts），胞質深藍、邊緣有空泡感，核染色質細並帶模糊包涵體；切片中大型細胞核內有嗜酸性玻璃狀包涵體（lantern cells），且缺乏成熟紅系細胞，是 parvovirus B19 造成純紅血球再生不良的典型表現。
features: Giant pronormoblasts (several times the size of neighboring cells) with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and fine peripheral vacuolation/scalloping
Large round nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and glassy, washed-out appearance suggestive of viral inclusions
Biopsy: large erythroid precursors with eosinophilic glassy intranuclear inclusions and peripheral chromatin margination
Paucity of maturing normoblasts; background of granulocytes and megakaryocytes preserved
Immunostain highlights the scattered large abnormal erythroid precursors (antigen not labeled in the figure)
61111.describe_en: Composite figure. Bone marrow aspirate smears show scattered giant pronormoblasts with deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and large nuclei with dispersed chromatin, while intermediate and late normoblasts are markedly reduced. The core biopsy shows preserved granulopoiesis and megakaryocytes with interspersed large erythroid precursors containing eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions and marginated chromatin. An immunostain (antigen not specified in the image) highlights these large cells. In an immunosuppressed transplant recipient, the findings are consistent with parvovirus B19-associated pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: PEL shows sheets of pronormoblasts that lack intranuclear viral inclusions and are often p53 strongly positive, whereas parvovirus shows scattered giant pronormoblasts with inclusions and positive B19 IHC/PCR.
Megaloblastic marrow is hypercellular with erythroid hyperplasia at all stages and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony rather than isolated giant pronormoblasts with maturation arrest.
Non-viral PRCA also shows absent erythroid maturation but lacks giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions, and parvovirus IHC/PCR is negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic tumor or large-cell lymphoma cells
ddx.vs: Tumor cells form clusters or sheets and are negative for erythroid markers (E-cadherin, glycophorin), while B19-infected cells are single erythroid precursors.

exam.answer_en: Parvovirus B19–associated pure red cell aplasia — giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions and absent erythroid maturation
pearls_zh: 考法：指巨大、胞質深藍有空泡的前紅血球問病因；切片中帶核內嗜酸性玻璃樣包涵體的細胞稱 lantern cells。
機轉：B19 以 P antigen（globoside）為受體感染紅系前驅細胞；缺乏 P 抗原者對感染具抗性。
臨床：慢性溶血病人（sickle cell、HS）可致 transient aplastic crisis；移植、HIV 等免疫低下者可致慢性 PRCA，網狀紅血球極低。
免疫低下者抗體反應差、血清學可能陰性，應以 B19 DNA PCR 確認；治療為 IVIG 並減少免疫抑制。
其他連結：兒童 fifth disease（slapped cheek）、孕婦感染可致 hydrops fetalis。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 pure erythroid leukemia；B19 為散在巨大前紅血球含核內包涵體、缺乏晚期紅系，PEL 則成片且無包涵體，可用 B19 IHC/PCR 區分。

quiz.q: 心臟移植病人貧血、網狀紅血球極低，骨髓見圖中巨大前紅血球，最可能病原？如何確認？
quiz.a: Parvovirus B19；血液 B19 DNA PCR（或骨髓 B19 IHC）

60983.recognize_zh: 冠狀切面腹部電腦斷層（CT）顯示脾臟極度腫大，從左上腹一路延伸越過中線、下達骨盆腔，把腸道推擠到右側與下方，肝臟亦明顯腫大，符合骨髓纖維化的巨脾（髓外造血）。
features: Coronal contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen and pelvis
Massively enlarged spleen extending from the left upper quadrant across the midline into the pelvis
Homogeneous splenic parenchymal enhancement without discrete focal lesions
Hepatomegaly with bowel loops displaced to the right lower abdomen
No morphologic (microscopic) information; imaging supports but does not establish the diagnosis
60983.describe_en: Coronal contrast-enhanced CT image demonstrates massive splenomegaly, with the spleen extending across the midline and into the pelvis and displacing bowel loops to the right and inferiorly. The splenic parenchyma is homogeneous without focal masses or infarcts evident on this single slice, and the liver is also enlarged. Massive splenomegaly of this degree is consistent with extramedullary hematopoiesis in primary myelofibrosis, though the imaging appearance itself is nonspecific.

ddx.vs: Can cause identical massive splenomegaly; distinguished by marked leukocytosis with basophilia and BCR::ABL1 on molecular testing.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia or splenic marginal zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: Also cause massive splenomegaly, but diagnosis rests on blood/marrow morphology and flow cytometry (CD25/CD103/CD11c or clonal B cells) rather than imaging.
Spleen may contain focal hypoechoic/hypodense Gaucher nodules or infarcts, with Gaucher cells in marrow and low glucocerebrosidase activity.
Distinguished clinically and by amastigotes in marrow macrophages or by hemoglobin analysis, not by splenic CT appearance.

60919.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中大量大型異型組織球樣細胞，細胞質豐富淡粉紅，偶見多核大細胞（空心箭頭），抹片插圖為具豐富空泡狀細胞質的大型異型細胞；CD163 瀰漫強陽性，而殘存 CD19 陽性 B 細胞稀少，符合發生於 B-ALL 後的組織球肉瘤。
features: Hypercellular marrow extensively replaced by large cells with abundant pale eosinophilic to foamy cytoplasm
Scattered large, multinucleated or bizarre atypical cells (arrowhead)
Focal residual small lymphoid/hematopoietic cells (blue arrow)
Aspirate inset: large atypical cell with irregular hyperchromatic nucleus and abundant vacuolated blue cytoplasm
IHC: diffuse strong CD163; CD19 only in scattered residual cells; P53 nuclear staining in a subset of large cells; pERK positivity in neoplastic cells
60919.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine is hypercellular and extensively infiltrated by large atypical cells with abundant pale eosinophilic to foamy cytoplasm, including multinucleated and bizarre forms, with only small residual foci of hematopoietic and lymphoid cells. The aspirate contains large atypical cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and vacuolated cytoplasm. The neoplastic cells are diffusely positive for CD163 and show pERK expression and P53 nuclear staining in a subset, whereas CD19 highlights only scattered residual B cells. In a patient with prior B-lymphoblastic leukemia, findings are consistent with histiocytic sarcoma, likely secondary (transdifferentiated); clonal relationship can be established by shared IGH rearrangement or cytogenetic abnormalities.

ddx.vs: Reactive histiocytes are cytologically bland with hemophagocytosis and lack the sheet-like replacement, marked atypia and multinucleated bizarre forms.
Relapse shows sheets of small CD19+/TdT+ blasts with scant cytoplasm, whereas here CD19 is limited to rare residual cells.
Monoblasts are smaller with fine chromatin and express CD34/CD117 or lysozyme with less abundant cytoplasm and no bizarre multinucleated cells.
ALCL hallmark cells are CD30+/ALK+ T cells and CD163 negative.

60919.stain: H&E; Wright-Giemsa; IHC: CD163, CD19, P53, pERK

60855.recognize_zh: 低倍痰液細胞學抹片中，在淡藍色黏液背景與零星發炎細胞之間，可見兩條細長、捲曲、呈紫紅色的線蟲幼蟲；痰液中出現線蟲幼蟲應優先想到糞小桿線蟲（Strongyloides stercoralis）過度感染症候群。
features: Two slender, coiled/looped nematode larvae staining purple, each several times longer than surrounding cells
Larvae lie within small patches of pale mucoid/fibrinous material
Background of thin mucus with sparse scattered inflammatory cell nuclei
Occasional orange-staining (keratinized) squamous cell, consistent with a Papanicolaou-stained respiratory specimen
Internal structures (buccal cavity, genital primordium, tail notch) not resolvable at this low magnification
60855.describe_en: Low-power view of a sputum cytology preparation shows two slender, coiled nematode larvae within a thin mucoid background containing sparse inflammatory cells and a rare keratinized squamous cell. The larvae are elongated with tapering ends; diagnostic internal detail such as the esophagus length, buccal cavity or notched tail cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Strongyloides stercoralis larvae in the respiratory tract, which should prompt evaluation for hyperinfection syndrome, particularly in immunosuppressed patients.

ddx.vs: Hookworm larvae migrate through the lungs but are rarely seen in sputum; rhabditiform hookworm larvae have a long buccal canal and filariform larvae a pointed rather than notched tail.
Ascaris larvae in Löffler syndrome are larger and thicker with a different anatomy and are seen only transiently early in infection.
Microfilariae are much thinner, often sheathed, found in blood, and have characteristic nuclear column patterns at the tail.
Plant/cotton fibers lack body wall and internal cellular structure, and free-living nematodes are excluded by clinical context and larval anatomy.

exam.answer_en: Strongyloides stercoralis larvae in sputum (Papanicolaou) — coiled nematode larvae indicating pulmonary involvement/hyperinfection
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指痰液中捲曲的紫色長條蟲體，問「這是什麼？代表什麼臨床狀況？」→ Strongyloides 幼蟲，痰液出現表示肺部侵犯，須考慮 hyperinfection syndrome。
高風險族群：使用類固醇（最重要）、HTLV-1 感染、移植、血液腫瘤化療病人；自體感染（autoinfection）使蟲可在體內持續數十年。
臨床急症：hyperinfection/disseminated strongyloidiasis 常併發 Gram-negative 菌血症或腦膜炎（幼蟲攜帶腸道菌），死亡率高；免疫抑制時嗜酸性球可不升高。
治療：ivermectin 為首選；流行區或有暴露史的病人在開始類固醇或免疫抑制前應篩檢或預防性治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為纖維、污染物或 hookworm 幼蟲：纖維無體壁與內部構造；hookworm 幼蟲少見於痰液，且絲狀幼蟲尾端尖，Strongyloides 絲狀幼蟲尾端有缺口（notched）。

quiz.q: 使用類固醇的病人痰液中看到圖中的線蟲幼蟲，最可能的病原與首選藥物為何？
quiz.a: Strongyloides stercoralis（hyperinfection syndrome）；ivermectin

60791.recognize_zh: 腎臟穿刺切片中腎小管間質看起來只是「細胞較多」（A、C、E），但 CD20 顯示大型 B 細胞塞滿管周微血管與腎絲球微血管（B、D），內皮標記（F）勾勒出血管輪廓，證明腫瘤細胞位於血管腔內，符合血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Panels A, C, E: renal cortex with hypercellular interstitium around tubules and a glomerulus, without a discrete mass
Large atypical cells within peritubular capillaries and glomerular capillary loops, easily mistaken for interstitial inflammation
Panel B: diffuse CD20 positivity throughout the core at low power
Panel D: CD20+ large cells filling and distending peritubular capillaries between unstained tubules
Panel F: endothelial marker (CD34) outlining capillaries, confirming the intravascular location of the tumor cells
60791.describe_en: Kidney biopsy H&E sections (A, C, E) show a hypercellular cortex in which the tubules and a glomerulus are surrounded by increased mononuclear cells, mimicking interstitial nephritis. CD20 immunostaining (B, D) reveals large B cells confined to and distending peritubular and glomerular capillaries, while an endothelial marker (F) outlines the vascular channels containing these cells. No extravascular mass is identified. Findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma involving the kidney.

ddx.vs: Inflammatory cells are small T cells, eosinophils and plasma cells in the interstitium with tubulitis, not CD20+ large cells within capillaries.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with renal involvement
ddx.vs: Forms destructive interstitial sheets or masses outside vessels rather than being restricted to vascular lumina.
Consists of small mature lymphocytes, often in interstitial nodules, rather than large atypical intravascular cells.
Capillaries contain neutrophils and monocytes with C4d positivity, not CD20+ large atypical lymphocytes.

exam.answer_en: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma in kidney — CD20+ large B cells confined to peritubular and glomerular capillaries outlined by CD34
pearls_zh: 考法：考官先給看似間質性腎炎的 H&E，再給 CD20/CD34，問「腫瘤細胞在哪裡？」→ 血管腔內，CD34 勾出內皮、CD20 細胞塞滿微血管，診斷 IVLBCL。
臨床：不明熱、LDH 明顯升高、血球低下，無明顯腫塊或淋巴結腫大；常侵犯皮膚與中樞神經。亞洲型（Asian variant）常合併噬血症候群與肝脾腫大。
診斷策略：影像找不到病灶時，隨機皮膚切片（random skin biopsy）與骨髓切片是重要取樣方式；骨髓腫瘤細胞可能只在竇內，需 CD20 才看得出。
治療與預後：以 R-CHOP 為基礎，因中樞神經復發風險高，常加入中樞神經預防（如高劑量 methotrexate）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為急性間質性腎炎：H&E 看似間質細胞增多，但 AIN 是間質內小 T 細胞、嗜酸性球與漿細胞並有 tubulitis；IVLBCL 為 CD20+ 大細胞限於血管腔內。

quiz.q: 腎切片 H&E 看似間質發炎，CD20 陽性大細胞塞滿管周微血管、CD34 勾出血管輪廓，診斷為何？
quiz.a: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma

60599.recognize_zh: 周邊血液的淋巴球核分成兩葉（雙核樣、binucleated/lobated lymphocyte），細胞質淡藍；骨髓切片 CD20 免疫染色可見竇內（intrasinusoidal）B 細胞排列，這是持續性多株 B 淋巴球增多症（PPBL）的典型組合。
features: Medium-sized lymphocyte with a bilobed nucleus giving a binucleate appearance
Moderately condensed chromatin and a rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Otherwise unremarkable red cells in the background
Bone marrow biopsy immunostain (B-cell marker, likely CD20): linear clusters of positive cells within sinusoids (intrasinusoidal pattern)
60599.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocyte with a deeply cleaved, bilobed nucleus producing a binucleate appearance, with mature chromatin and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm. Immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow biopsy highlights B cells arranged in linear aggregates within sinusoids. In a patient with lymphocytosis, these findings are suggestive of persistent polyclonal B-cell lymphocytosis, typically seen in young female smokers with HLA-DR7, polyclonal IgM elevation and isochromosome 3q; polyclonality should be confirmed by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Also shows intrasinusoidal marrow infiltration, but cells are villous lymphocytes with monotypic light-chain restriction rather than polyclonal binucleated lymphocytes.
CLL cells are small round lymphocytes with soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, CD5+/CD23+ and light-chain restricted.
ATLL cells have multilobated flower-like nuclei and are CD4+ T cells with HTLV-1 serology, not polyclonal B cells.
Shows hairy cytoplasmic projections, CD11c/CD25/CD103 and BRAF V600E with diffuse fried-egg marrow infiltrate, not bilobed nuclei.

60663.recognize_zh: 淋巴結抽吸抹片中一條細長的微血管／纖維間質束兩側整齊排列著漿細胞（偏心核、深藍胞質與核周淡染區），形如緞帶（plasma cell ribbon）；背景混合嗜中性球、嗜酸性球與淋巴球，高倍下亦見核仁明顯的大型細胞，符合古典何杰金淋巴瘤的混合性發炎背景。
features: Elongated capillary/stromal strand with spindle-shaped endothelial nuclei running through the smear
Plasma cells lining both sides of the strand in a ribbon-like row, with eccentric round nuclei, clock-face chromatin, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Occasional larger cells with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli admixed along the strand (panel B)
Polymorphous background of neutrophils, eosinophils, and small lymphocytes (panel A)
No sheets of monotonous large atypical cells
60663.describe_en: Lymph node aspirate smear shows a long capillary or fibrovascular strand with spindle-shaped endothelial nuclei, along which numerous plasma cells are aligned in a ribbon-like arrangement. The plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin, basophilic cytoplasm, and perinuclear clearing; a few larger cells with open chromatin and prominent nucleoli are also present. The background is polymorphous, with neutrophils, eosinophils, and small lymphocytes. Findings reflect a reactive plasma cell-rich inflammatory milieu, which in this case accompanies classic Hodgkin lymphoma; diagnosis requires identification of Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells with a CD30/CD15-positive phenotype.

ddx.vs: Plasmacytoma shows sheets of monotypic plasma cells with light-chain restriction, whereas here plasma cells are part of a mixed inflammatory background and polytypic.
Reactive nodes can be plasma cell-rich with eosinophils but lack CD30/CD15-positive Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells.
AITL also shows plasma cells, eosinophils, and arborizing vessels, but contains clear atypical CD4/PD-1/CD10-positive T cells and clonal TCR rearrangement rather than RS cells.
Castleman disease shows sheets of interfollicular plasma cells with regressed follicles on histology and HHV-8/IL-6 association, without HRS cells.

60727.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中有成團的中大型細胞，核互相擠壓 (nuclear molding)、染色質細緻、細胞質少，外觀像高惡性淋巴瘤；但團塊細胞呈強烈核染色，另一標記呈顆粒狀細胞質陽性，符合小細胞肺癌轉移，而旁邊散在的小型淋巴球則代表同時存在的 B 細胞淋巴增生。
features: Panel A: cohesive clusters of medium-sized cells with high N:C ratio, finely granular chromatin and nuclear molding, crush-prone appearance
Panel A: adjacent residual hematopoietic cells and small lymphocytes
Panel B: strong diffuse nuclear staining confined to the tumor clusters (marker unlabeled, pattern fits TTF-1)
Panel C: scattered small cells with IHC positivity outside clusters (marker unlabeled, possibly the B-cell population)
Panel D: dot-like/granular cytoplasmic positivity in a cluster of tumor cells (pattern fits a neuroendocrine marker)
60727.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows cohesive clusters of medium-sized tumor cells with scant cytoplasm, finely dispersed chromatin and nuclear molding, set among residual hematopoietic elements and small lymphocytes. Immunostains (markers not labeled in the figure) show strong nuclear staining restricted to the clusters, granular cytoplasmic staining typical of a neuroendocrine marker, and a separate stain highlighting scattered small cells. Findings are consistent with metastatic small cell carcinoma mimicking high-grade lymphoma, with a coexisting small lymphoid population that should be characterized separately.

ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are discohesive without nuclear molding and are CD45/CD20 positive, whereas small cell carcinoma forms cohesive molded clusters positive for keratin (dot-like), TTF-1 and neuroendocrine markers.
Blasts are TdT+/CD34+ and grow as a diffuse discohesive sheet rather than cohesive clusters.

ddx.dx: Merkel cell carcinoma or other small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Merkel cell carcinoma is CK20 perinuclear-dot positive and TTF-1 negative; Ewing sarcoma is CD99/NKX2.2 positive.

60535.recognize_zh: 這是免疫組織化學染色（未標示抗體），許多散在細胞的細胞質呈粗顆粒狀棕色陽性，背景為核淡、卵圓形的大細胞群；此顆粒狀陽性型態類似細胞毒性顆粒蛋白（如 TIA-1、granzyme B）或溶小體標記（如 CD68），需對照原始說明判讀。
features: IHC with brown DAB chromogen and hematoxylin counterstain; antibody not labeled
Numerous scattered cells with coarse, granular to dot-like cytoplasmic positivity
Background of negative cells with oval to reniform, pale vesicular nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm, suggestive of epithelioid histiocytes
Positive cells are small-to-medium, interspersed rather than forming sheets
Faint diffuse background staining
60535.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a lymphoid lesion shows numerous scattered small-to-medium cells with coarse granular cytoplasmic positivity, distributed among a background of negative cells with pale oval to reniform nuclei and abundant cytoplasm resembling epithelioid histiocytes. The antibody is not specified, so the stained population cannot be definitively assigned; a granular cytoplasmic pattern of this kind is typical of cytotoxic granule proteins (TIA-1, granzyme B, perforin) or lysosomal markers such as CD68. In the context of the title, the image illustrates the mixed population of lymphoepithelioid cell (Lennert) lymphoma, a variant of peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS, in which neoplastic T cells frequently show a cytotoxic phenotype amid abundant epithelioid histiocytes.

ddx.vs: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, which are absent from the lymphoepithelioid variant of PTCL.
Toxoplasmosis shows small epithelioid clusters encroaching on reactive follicles with monocytoid B cells and a polyclonal T-cell population.
AITL shows arborizing high endothelial venules, expanded CD21+ follicular dendritic meshworks and a TFH phenotype (PD1, CXCL13).
Reactive granulomas form discrete aggregates and lack a clonal atypical T-cell population by TCR studies.

60471.recognize_zh: BCL6 免疫染色下，大多數中至大型腫瘤細胞呈強烈細胞核陽性，僅散在的梭形間質細胞與小細胞為陰性；表示腫瘤具生發中心（germinal center）表型，與濾泡性淋巴瘤 3B 級相符。
features: Diffuse to vaguely nested population of medium to large cells with strong nuclear BCL6 staining
Positive nuclei are round to irregular, some vesicular with speckled staining
Majority of tumor cells positive; staining intensity varies from moderate to strong
Negative spindle-shaped stromal/endothelial cells and small cells interspersed
Follicular architecture cannot be assessed at this magnification
60471.describe_en: BCL6 immunohistochemical stain shows strong nuclear positivity in the majority of medium to large neoplastic cells, with variable intensity and interspersed negative stromal and endothelial cells. Architecture is not well assessed at this magnification. BCL6 expression indicates a germinal center B-cell phenotype, which in a follicular proliferation composed of sheets of centroblasts supports follicular lymphoma, grade 3B.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, GCB type
ddx.vs: DLBCL also expresses BCL6 but shows diffuse effacement without a CD21/CD23-positive follicular dendritic meshwork, and diffuse areas beside FL 3B are diagnosed as DLBCL.
Low-grade FL is also BCL6+ but is composed predominantly of small centrocytes with fewer than 15 centroblasts/HPF.
Reactive germinal centers are BCL6+ but polarized, BCL2-negative with tingible-body macrophages and a very high organized Ki-67.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized, BCL6+/CD10+ but BCL2-negative with near 100% Ki-67 and MYC rearrangement.

60279.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數顆比周圍細胞大好幾倍的巨大前紅血球母細胞（giant pronormoblast），細胞質深藍、邊緣有小突起，核內染色質淡化並見玻璃狀紫色核內包涵體，呈「燈籠細胞」外觀，是微小病毒 B19（parvovirus B19）感染的典型線索。
features: Giant pronormoblasts, several times the size of surrounding cells, with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and occasional cytoplasmic blebs
Large round nuclei with finely stippled, cleared chromatin
Glassy, dark violet intranuclear inclusion in at least one giant pronormoblast, giving a 'lantern cell' appearance
Few maturing erythroid precursors (red cell hypoplasia) with background neutrophils, myelocytes, lymphocytes and mitotic figures
Scattered small dark late erythroid/lymphoid nuclei and red cells in background
60279.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several giant pronormoblasts that are many times the size of adjacent cells, with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, focal cytoplasmic blebbing and large round nuclei with finely stippled, partly cleared chromatin. At least one giant pronormoblast contains a glassy violet intranuclear inclusion, imparting the characteristic 'lantern cell' appearance. Maturing erythroid precursors are sparse, while granulocytic cells, lymphocytes and occasional mitotic figures are present. In a patient with isolated anemia and red cell hypoplasia, findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 infection; confirmation by parvovirus PCR or immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of proliferating proerythroblasts comprising most of the marrow without viral inclusions, whereas here giant pronormoblasts are scattered in a background of erythroid hypoplasia.
Megaloblastic marrow is erythroid hyperplastic with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony across all stages and giant bands/metamyelocytes, not isolated giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions.

ddx.dx: Congenital dyserythropoietic anemia or Diamond-Blackfan anemia
ddx.vs: CDA shows multinucleated late erythroblasts with internuclear bridging, and DBA shows erythroid aplasia without giant inclusion-bearing pronormoblasts; parvovirus testing separates them.
These lack the deep blue erythroid cytoplasm and glassy intranuclear inclusions and are CD61 or keratin positive rather than E-cadherin/CD71 positive.

exam.answer_en: Parvovirus B19 infection — giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions ('lantern cells') on a background of erythroid hypoplasia
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著比周圍大數倍、胞質深藍的巨大前紅母細胞問「這是什麼細胞、什麼病毒」——答 giant pronormoblast，parvovirus B19。
機轉：B19 以 P antigen（globoside）為受體感染紅系前驅細胞並造成凋亡；缺乏 P antigen 者不易感染。周邊血表現為網狀紅血球極低（reticulocytopenia）。
臨床情境三型：慢性溶血病人（遺傳性球形紅血球症、鐮刀型貧血）的 transient aplastic crisis；免疫低下者的慢性 pure red cell aplasia；孕婦感染致 hydrops fetalis。
診斷：免疫低下者可能不產生 IgM，需用 parvovirus B19 DNA PCR 或骨髓 IHC；免疫低下的慢性 PRCA 可用 IVIG 治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 pure erythroid leukemia 或 megaloblastic anemia；前者是成片的 proerythroblast 佔據骨髓，後者紅系增生且各階段皆有核質不同步，本圖是紅系低下背景中零星的巨大前紅母細胞帶核內包涵體。

quiz.q: 圖中巨大、胞質深藍並帶核內包涵體的細胞是什麼？這個病毒在溶血性貧血病人會引起什麼併發症？
quiz.a: Giant pronormoblast（parvovirus B19）；transient aplastic crisis（網狀紅血球驟降）。

60151.recognize_zh: 這是雙色雙融合（dual-color dual-fusion）BCR/ABL1間期FISH示意圖：正常細胞為兩紅（ABL1）兩綠（BCR）分開的訊號；異常細胞只剩一紅一綠，另出現兩個紅綠相疊的黃色融合訊號，代表t(9;22)形成BCR::ABL1。
features: Interphase nuclei counterstained blue (DAPI) hybridized with ABL1 (9q34, red) and BCR (22q11.2, green) probes
Normal cells: two separate red and two separate green signals (2R2G), BCR::ABL1 negative
Abnormal cells: one red, one green and two red-green juxtaposed/yellow fusion signals (1R1G2F)
Two fusion signals reflect both derivative chromosomes der(22) (Philadelphia) and der(9) of the reciprocal t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)
60151.describe_en: This figure illustrates interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization using a dual-color, dual-fusion BCR/ABL1 probe set, with ABL1 at 9q34 labeled red and BCR at 22q11.2 labeled green. Normal nuclei show two separate red and two separate green signals (2R2G). Abnormal nuclei show one red, one green and two fused red-green (yellow) signals (1R1G2F), indicating the reciprocal t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) with formation of BCR::ABL1 on the Philadelphia chromosome and ABL1::BCR on der(9). A positive result supports chronic myeloid leukemia or Ph-positive acute leukemia and excludes BCR::ABL1-negative MPN/MDS-MPN entities such as atypical CML; variant patterns (e.g., one fusion from der(9) deletion) should be recognized.

ddx.vs: Deletion of sequences on der(9) produces a 2R2G-minus pattern with a single fusion (1R1G1F) instead of two fusions, still indicating BCR::ABL1 but associated with prior prognostic differences.

Chance colocalization of signals in 2D nuclei yields single apparent fusions in a low percentage of normal cells, so laboratory cutoffs and the extra-signal dual-fusion design are used to reduce false positives.

exam.answer_en: BCR::ABL1 dual-color dual-fusion interphase FISH — normal 2R2G versus abnormal 1R1G2F pattern indicating t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)
pearls_zh: 判讀：ABL1 紅、BCR 綠；正常細胞 2R2G。典型 t(9;22) 為 1R1G2F，兩個融合訊號分別來自 der(22)（Ph）與 der(9)。
變異模式要會：der(9) deletion 時只見一個融合訊號（1F 型），其預後意義在 TKI 時代已減弱；額外 Ph 複製（+Ph）則出現多個融合訊號，提示疾病進展。
FISH 的限制：無法區分 p190 與 p210 轉錄本，也不適合作深度分子反應監測；治療監測應以 BCR::ABL1 quantitative RT-PCR（International Scale）為主，MMR 定義為 ≤0.1% IS。
Interphase FISH 不需分裂細胞、可用周邊血，對 cryptic insertion 造成的 Ph-negative 但 BCR::ABL1 陽性病例特別有用。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常見錯誤是把兩個訊號在 3D 空間中偶然重疊當成融合（false-positive fusion）；因此 dual-fusion 探針需同時見到兩個融合訊號才判陽性，並設有 cutoff 值、計數足量細胞。

quiz.q: 使用 BCR/ABL1 dual-color dual-fusion 探針，典型 t(9;22) 陽性細胞的訊號模式為何？這項檢查能否區分 p190 與 p210？
quiz.a: 1R1G2F（一紅一綠兩融合）；不能，需 RT-PCR。

60087.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片高倍下充滿大型芽細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻、多有一至兩個明顯大核仁，細胞質淡灰藍、幾乎無顆粒；芽細胞占絕大多數（72%），需搭配小型低分葉巨核細胞與 inv(3) 核型診斷。
features: Sheets of large blasts dominating the field
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and one to two prominent nucleoli
Moderate pale gray-blue, largely agranular cytoplasm
Occasional smaller cells with condensed chromatin (residual lymphocytes or erythroid precursors)
No Auer rods identified in this field
60087.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows sheets of large blasts with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, one to two prominent nucleoli and moderate pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm. Occasional smaller cells with condensed chromatin are admixed. No Auer rods are identified in this field, and dysplastic megakaryocytes are not included in this view. With 72% blasts and cytogenetic inv(3)(q21q26.2), findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with inv(3)/MECOM rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Blast morphology overlaps; demonstration of inv(3)/t(3;3) with MECOM rearrangement by karyotype or FISH defines the genetic entity.
Lymphoblasts have scantier cytoplasm and less prominent nucleoli and lack MPO and myeloid antigens.
Megakaryoblasts often show cytoplasmic blebs and express CD41/CD61, while inv(3) AML blasts are usually CD34+/CD13+/CD33+ and may express CD7.

60023.recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片表皮完整，真皮全層被瀰漫、密集的單一圓形細胞浸潤取代，腫瘤細胞在膠原束之間穿插生長、並未侵入表皮；這種瀰漫性真皮浸潤需搭配高倍型態與免疫染色才能判定為骨髓肉瘤。
features: Intact, unremarkable epidermis without epidermotropism
Dense, diffuse sheet-like infiltrate of monotonous small-to-medium round cells filling the dermis
Tumor cells dissect between residual collagen bundles, more visible in the deep dermis
Infiltrate extends up to the papillary dermis beneath the epidermis
Low magnification; cytologic details such as nucleoli and mitoses not assessable
60023.describe_en: Skin biopsy at low power shows an intact epidermis overlying a dense, diffuse infiltrate that effaces the dermis. The infiltrate is composed of monotonous small to medium round cells growing in sheets and splaying residual collagen bundles, extending up to the papillary dermis without epidermal involvement. Adnexal structures are not apparent in this field. The pattern indicates a diffuse dermal hematolymphoid or blastic infiltrate; with higher-power blastic cytology and myeloid immunophenotype, the findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma (leukemia cutis).

ddx.vs: BPDCN produces an identical diffuse dermal infiltrate sparing the epidermis, so CD4, CD56, CD123, TCF4 positivity with MPO negativity is required to separate it.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type
ddx.vs: DLBCL leg type is composed of large centroblasts/immunoblasts that are CD20, BCL2, and MUM1 positive and MPO negative.

ddx.dx: Mycosis fungoides or other cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: MF typically shows epidermotropism with atypical lymphocytes in the epidermis, which is absent here.
Merkel cell carcinoma forms dermal sheets of small blue cells but is CK20 dot-positive and neuroendocrine marker positive.

22647.recognize_zh: 許多紅血球的血紅素縮向一側，另一側留下透明膜囊（blister／hemighost 細胞），並見邊緣缺一口的咬痕細胞（bite cells）、濃縮不規則細胞與棘狀紅血球；幼兒吃蠶豆後急性黃疸，符合 G6PD 缺乏症的蠶豆症氧化性溶血。
features: Blister cells/hemighosts with hemoglobin condensed to one side and a clear membrane-bound space
Bite cells with small semicircular defects at the cell margin
Irregularly contracted, densely staining red cells
Scattered echinocyte-like crenated cells
Neutrophil present; no schistocytes or agglutination
22647.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous oxidatively damaged red cells, including blister cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side of the cell, bite cells with marginal defects and irregularly contracted dense cells. Scattered crenated cells are also present, while schistocytes and agglutination are absent. In a 15-month-old boy with acute jaundice, findings are consistent with acute oxidant hemolysis due to G6PD deficiency (favism); a supravital Heinz body preparation and a G6PD assay repeated after the reticulocyte response subsides are recommended, since levels may be falsely normal during hemolysis.

ddx.vs: HS shows round uniformly dense spherocytes without bite cells or eccentric hemoglobin, and has a positive family history and EMA-binding defect.
AIHA shows spherocytes and polychromasia with a positive DAT rather than blister and bite cells.
HUS shows schistocytes, thrombocytopenia and renal failure rather than oxidative bite and blister cells.
Unstable Hb also produces Heinz and bite cells but G6PD activity is normal and Hb stability testing is abnormal.

exam.answer_en: Favism (G6PD deficiency) — acute oxidant hemolysis with blister cells/hemighosts, bite cells and contracted dense red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：指著 blister cell 與 bite cell 問名稱與機轉 → 氧化使血紅素變性成 Heinz bodies，脾臟移除後留下咬痕或偏心透明區。
G6PD 缺乏為 X-linked，男童較常見；台灣新生兒篩檢已常規納入 G6PD。
急性溶血期 G6PD 活性可因網狀紅血球增加而假性正常，應於數週至數月後複驗，或做分子檢測。
衛教避免蠶豆、樟腦丸（naphthalene）及 primaquine、dapsone、rasburicase 等氧化藥物；急性期以支持療法與必要時輸血為主。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 hereditary spherocytosis 或 AIHA 的球形紅血球；spherocyte 為圓形均勻深染，blister/bite cell 則有偏心透明區或邊緣缺口，且 DAT 陰性。

quiz.q: 幼兒吃蠶豆後急性黃疸，血片中邊緣缺一口的紅血球叫什麼？supravital 染色可看到什麼包涵體？
quiz.a: Bite cell；Heinz bodies

24183.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中早期紅血球母細胞（深藍細胞質）與另一顆前驅細胞的細胞質內有多個清楚的空泡，旁邊中性球分葉異常；早期前驅細胞出現細胞質空泡、再加上神經病變與腸胃症狀，應想到銅缺乏（copper deficiency）這個不常見的貧血原因。
features: Early erythroid precursor (proerythroblast) with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and discrete small cytoplasmic vacuoles (panel A)
Larger precursor with gray-blue cytoplasm containing multiple clear vacuoles (panel B)
Nearby neutrophils with abnormal/hypolobated nuclear segmentation
Scattered extracellular pink-red granular material in the background of panel A
Red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis
24183.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show early erythroid and myeloid precursors containing multiple discrete cytoplasmic vacuoles, including a proerythroblast with intensely basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm. Adjacent neutrophils show abnormal nuclear segmentation. Ring sideroblast assessment is not possible without an iron stain. In a patient with neuropathy and gastrointestinal symptoms, vacuolization of early hematopoietic precursors raises copper deficiency (e.g. from malabsorption or zinc excess) as the cause of anemia; serum copper and ceruloplasmin should be measured.

ddx.vs: MDS shows dysplasia with clonal cytogenetic abnormalities and does not reverse, whereas copper-deficiency vacuoles and dyspoiesis resolve with copper repletion.
Ethanol also vacuolates early precursors; history and normal serum copper/ceruloplasmin distinguish it.
Drug-induced precursor vacuolation is morphologically identical and requires medication history.
Erythroid leukemia shows sheets of vacuolated proerythroblasts (>=30% of cells) with marked atypia rather than scattered vacuolated precursors.

exam.answer_en: Copper deficiency — cytoplasmic vacuolization of early erythroid and myeloid precursors with dysplastic-appearing neutrophils
pearls_zh: 考法：指著原紅血球胞質內的空泡問「前驅細胞空泡化的鑑別？」→ copper deficiency、酒精、chloramphenicol、linezolid。
銅缺乏原因：減重或胃繞道手術、吸收不良、過量鋅攝取（如含鋅假牙黏著劑）；驗 serum copper、ceruloplasmin、zinc。
血液表現為貧血、neutropenia，骨髓可見 ring sideroblasts；神經表現為類似 B12 缺乏的 myeloneuropathy。
補充銅後血球減少多可恢復，但神經症狀常無法完全回復，故早期辨識很重要。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤診為 MDS；銅缺乏的發育不良與空泡在補銅後可逆，且無克隆性染色體異常，送 MDS 診斷前應先驗銅與鋅。

quiz.q: 早期紅系前驅細胞胞質出現多個空泡，合併神經病變的病人應先驗哪兩項以排除可逆原因？
quiz.a: Serum copper 與 ceruloplasmin（並驗 zinc）

18487.recognize_zh: 這是臨床試驗設計示意圖（非形態學影像）：英國主導的低腫瘤負荷濾泡性淋巴瘤試驗，隨機分為 A 臂觀察等待、B 臂 rituximab 誘導 4 劑、C 臂誘導加維持治療，並標示規定的 CT 與骨髓 MRD 評估時間點。
features: Randomization into three arms displayed as timelines of clinic visits
Arm A: watch and wait with clinic visits only
Arm B: rituximab induction (four weekly doses, arrows at start)
Arm C: rituximab induction followed by repeated maintenance doses
Compulsory CT scans at defined time points, CT for clinical CR, and bone marrow histology/MRD only if CT shows CR
Progressive disease requiring therapy stops protocol treatment
18487.describe_en: This non-morphologic figure is the schema of the UK-led randomized trial in asymptomatic low-tumor-burden follicular lymphoma comparing watch and wait with single-agent rituximab. Patients were randomized to watch and wait (arm A), rituximab induction of four weekly doses (arm B), or rituximab induction followed by maintenance (arm C). Response assessment included compulsory CT scans at set intervals, with bone marrow histology and minimal residual disease testing performed only when CT showed complete response, and progression requiring therapy ended protocol treatment. The trial showed that rituximab delayed the need for new treatment, although an overall survival benefit was not demonstrated.

16055.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中出現成群、黏聚的大型細胞，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色並帶小空泡，細胞核大、染色質細緻且有核仁，形態不像正常造血細胞，在縱膈生殖細胞瘤病人需考慮腫瘤細胞侵犯骨髓或伴隨的巨核母細胞性白血病。
features: Large atypical cells several times the size of adjacent lymphocytes, forming cohesive aggregates/syncytial clusters
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and irregular, ill-defined borders
Large round to oval nuclei with finely granular, open chromatin and small nucleoli
Left panel: a giant cell with a large nucleus closely associated with smaller round cells at its periphery
Right panel: tight cluster of large cells intermixed with smaller dark lymphoid/erythroid cells
Background of red cells with crenation/drying artifact
16055.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show clusters of large atypical cells with abundant gray-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm, large round-oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, forming cohesive aggregates with smaller hematopoietic cells closely apposed. These cells do not resemble normal marrow elements. On morphology alone, metastatic germ cell tumor cells cannot be separated from megakaryoblasts or malignant histiocytes, both of which occur in association with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by a non-hematopoietic or GCT-associated neoplasm; immunophenotyping (SALL4, OCT3/4, CD30, AFP, keratin versus CD41/CD61, CD163) and i(12p) testing are required.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia associated with mediastinal germ cell tumor
ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts show cytoplasmic blebs, express CD41/CD61 and are keratin/SALL4 negative, although they share i(12p) with the germ cell tumor.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters that are keratin positive but SALL4/OCT3/4 negative, with a primary site outside the mediastinal germ cell context.
Histiocytic neoplasms show hemophagocytosis and CD163/CD68/lysozyme positivity rather than germ cell markers.
Osteoblasts are eccentric-nucleated with a perinuclear hof and osteoclasts are multinucleated with separate uniform nuclei, both lacking nuclear atypia.

3319.recognize_zh: 大型腫瘤細胞同時呈清楚的細胞膜陽性與核旁點狀（Golgi 區）強陽性，是 ALCL 中 CD30 的典型染色模式；周圍小細胞為陰性。圖中未標示抗體。
features: Sheets of large cells with crisp, circumferential membranous brown staining
Strong dot-like paranuclear (Golgi) staining in most positive cells
Faint granular cytoplasmic staining in addition to membrane and Golgi positivity
Large round to reniform vesicular nuclei with hematoxylin counterstain; occasional mitotic figure
Scattered small negative background cells; antibody not labeled in the image
3319.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain shows sheets of large neoplastic cells with strong membranous staining and prominent dot-like paranuclear Golgi accentuation, with small negative background cells interspersed. The antibody is not labeled; this membrane-plus-Golgi pattern is the characteristic staining pattern of CD30. In the context of the title, the findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma, and ALK immunostaining is needed to determine ALK status.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin cells show the same CD30 membrane-Golgi pattern but are scattered singly in an inflammatory background and are CD15+ and ALK negative.
Its CD30 pattern is identical, so an ALK immunostain is required to separate ALK-positive from ALK-negative ALCL.
Embryonal carcinoma is CD30 positive but also cytokeratin, OCT4 and SALL4 positive and CD45 negative.
It shows heterogeneous CD30 and expresses CD20/PAX5.

exam.answer_en: ALCL in bone marrow — IHC (antibody unlabeled) with strong membranous and paranuclear Golgi staining of large cells, the characteristic CD30 pattern
pearls_zh: 考法：給一張未標示抗體的 IHC，問「這種膜＋核旁點狀的染色型態最可能是哪個抗體」；CD30 在 ALCL 為強而一致陽性，是與其他 CD30+ 淋巴瘤區分的特點之一。
ALK IHC 染色位置可推測融合夥伴：NPM1::ALK 為核＋細胞質陽性；其他夥伴（如 TPM3::ALK）多只有細胞質或膜陽性。
CD30 陽性不具特異性：cHL、部分 DLBCL、primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma、活化 immunoblasts、embryonal carcinoma 也可陽性；需搭配 ALK、EMA、PAX5、keratin 等 panel。
治療連結：CD30 表現是 brentuximab vedotin 的治療標的；ALK+ 復發/難治病例可考慮 ALK 抑制劑（如 crizotinib）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 Golgi 點狀陽性當成非特異性背景染色，或因 CD30+ 就直接診斷 ALCL；cHL 也呈膜＋Golgi 型態，embryonal carcinoma 亦 CD30+，需加 ALK、PAX5、SALL4/OCT3/4、keratin 區分。

quiz.q: 圖中腫瘤細胞呈膜陽性加核旁點狀陽性，最可能是哪個抗體？接下來需做哪個 IHC 決定亞型？
quiz.a: CD30；ALK

1399.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見中大型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少且深藍，邊緣長出多個像泡泡般的細胞質突起（cytoplasmic blebs），這是巨核母細胞（megakaryoblast）的經典外觀。
features: Medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with fine to slightly condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Scant deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Prominent cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopods budding from the cell surface
Two blasts adherent to each other; a smaller atypical cell nearby
Background erythrocytes with few platelets
1399.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round nuclei with fine chromatin, and scant deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm. The blasts display distinctive cytoplasmic blebs and bud-like projections at the cell margin, and two cells are clustered together. Platelets are sparse. Findings are suggestive of megakaryoblasts, as seen in acute megakaryoblastic leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry for CD41/CD42b/CD61 is required.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts may show small blebs but lack megakaryocytic markers; immunophenotyping (CD41/CD61 vs TdT/CD19/CD3) is required.
Myeloblasts usually have less cytoplasmic budding and express MPO or CD13/CD33 rather than CD41/CD61.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Tumor cells tend to form cohesive clumps and are CD45 negative, whereas megakaryoblasts circulate singly and express platelet glycoproteins.

ddx.dx: Transient abnormal myelopoiesis of Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical; distinguished by constitutional trisomy 21, GATA1 mutation and neonatal onset.

exam.answer_en: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia — megakaryoblasts with fine chromatin, scant deep blue cytoplasm and bleb-like cytoplasmic projections
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指有泡泡狀胞質突起的母細胞，問最可能的系列（megakaryoblast），並問形態無法確認時應做什麼（flow/IHC 看 CD41、CD61、CD42b）。
表型：megakaryoblast MPO 細胞化學陰性，CD41、CD61（及 CD42b）陽性，CD34/CD45 可能弱或陰性；骨髓常纖維化致 dry tap，需以切片 CD61 IHC 評估。
兒童相關遺傳：Down syndrome 的 myeloid leukemia（GATA1 突變，可有前驅 TAM）；非 DS 嬰兒 t(1;22) RBM15::MRTFA；CBFA2T3::GLIS2 預後差。
成人 AMKL 常伴 myelodysplasia-related 變化、複雜核型或 TP53 異常，預後差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 lymphoblast（ALL）或把貼附在母細胞上的血小板當成 bleb：胞質 bleb 本身非特異，確診需 CD41/CD61 陽性且 MPO 陰性，勿單憑形態。

quiz.q: 圖中母細胞邊緣的泡泡狀胞質突起提示哪一系？確認需要哪些標記？
quiz.a: Megakaryoblast（巨核細胞系）；CD41、CD61（CD42b），MPO 陰性。

2359.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被膜下與髓質的淋巴竇極度擴張，充滿淡染的大型組織球，把深紫色淋巴組織擠壓成網狀、分枝的條索，呈現「淡色竇、深色索」的地圖樣圖案，是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的經典結構。
features: Lymph node with thickened capsule and perinodal fibroadipose tissue at the left
Markedly dilated sinuses filled with pale-staining histiocytes
Residual lymphoid tissue compressed into dark, anastomosing medullary cords
Distinct pale sinus / dark cord alternating pattern at low power
Individual cytologic detail (emperipolesis) not resolvable at this magnification
2359.describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node (H&E) shows a capsule with adjacent perinodal tissue and marked distension of subcapsular and medullary sinuses by sheets of pale-staining histiocytes. The residual lymphoid parenchyma is compressed into dark, anastomosing cords, producing a striking pale-dark alternating pattern. Cytologic details such as emperipolesis cannot be assessed at this magnification. The architecture is suggestive of Rosai-Dorfman disease (sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy).

ddx.vs: Reactive sinus histiocytosis rarely distends sinuses to this degree and lacks large S100-positive histiocytes with emperipolesis.

ddx.dx: Langerhans cell histiocytosis in lymph node
ddx.vs: LCH also fills sinuses but cells have grooved nuclei, eosinophils and necrosis, and are CD1a positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in sinuses
ddx.vs: Tumor cells show cohesive clusters and nuclear atypia at higher power with lineage-specific markers.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma, sinusoidal pattern
ddx.vs: ALCL cells are pleomorphic hallmark cells that are CD30 positive rather than bland histiocytes.

exam.answer_en: Rosai-Dorfman disease (low power) — markedly distended lymph node sinuses filled with pale histiocytes, compressing dark lymphoid cords
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍結構題，考官指淡染擴張的竇與深色條索，問結構診斷（sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy），並要求說出高倍下應找的現象（emperipolesis）。
必考 IHC：RDD 組織球 S100+、CD68+、CD163+，但 CD1a−、langerin（CD207）−；S100 染色可清楚勾勒出被包入的淋巴球（emperipolesis）。
經典臨床：年輕人雙側無痛性巨大頸部淋巴結腫大、發燒、ESR 升高、多株高γ球蛋白血症；也可結節外侵犯（皮膚、鼻竇、眼眶、CNS）；多數病程良性或自限。
分類：組織球疾病 2016 修訂分類中屬 R group；部分病例帶 KRAS、MAP2K1 等 MAPK 路徑變異，提示部分 RDD 為克隆性疾病。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為非特異性反應性 sinus histiocytosis 或淋巴結轉移癌（竇內浸潤）：反應性者竇擴張較輕、組織球小且 S100−；轉移癌 keratin+；RDD 組織球大、S100+ 並有 emperipolesis。

quiz.q: 此低倍淋巴結中淡染擴張的區域是哪個構造？裡面充滿什麼細胞？
quiz.a: 淋巴竇（sinuses）；大型 S100+ 組織球（Rosai-Dorfman disease）。

1655.recognize_zh: 一團大型細胞彼此黏聚、共用淡紫灰色細顆粒狀細胞質而呈融合狀（syncytial），核大、卵圓形、染色質粗顆粒狀，細胞界線不清，形態與周圍零散的造血細胞不同，提示骨髓中的外來非造血腫瘤細胞。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells with indistinct borders forming a syncytial-appearing aggregate
Large oval to round nuclei with coarsely granular, clumped chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous at this resolution
Abundant pale lavender-grey, finely granular to microvacuolated shared cytoplasm
Mild nuclear size variation with some nuclear overlapping
Adjacent individual hematopoietic cells and red cells with drying artifact
1655.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive, syncytial-appearing cluster of large cells with abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders. The nuclei are large and oval with coarsely granular chromatin and mild size variation. These cells differ in cohesion and cytology from the scattered hematopoietic elements. Findings are suggestive of metastatic non-hematopoietic tumor cells; immunohistochemistry on the core biopsy or clot section (e.g. cytokeratin, CD45) is needed for confirmation and lineage assignment.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts are discrete cells with eccentric nuclei, a perinuclear hof set away from the nucleus, and deeper blue cytoplasm, rather than a syncytial clump with shared pale cytoplasm.
A megakaryocyte has a single multilobated nucleus, whereas this aggregate contains multiple separate nuclei from different cells.
Osteoclasts have many small uniform round nuclei with nucleoli, and macrophages contain phagocytosed debris, neither of which matches these large coarse-chromatin nuclei.

ddx.dx: Clumped plasma cells or lymphoma cells
ddx.vs: Hematopoietic neoplasms are usually discohesive with eccentric nuclei or basophilic cytoplasm and are CD45 or CD138 positive, unlike cohesive cytokeratin-positive epithelial clusters.

2615.recognize_zh: 切片中大片淡紫色、邊界模糊的上皮樣組織球，核呈卵圓形、染色質淡，周圍混有小淋巴球與一些深色顆粒狀色素，構成非壞死性肉芽腫的樣貌。
features: Sheets of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm and indistinct borders
Oval to elongated vesicular nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Scattered to clustered small lymphocytes with dense round nuclei, denser at the right edge
Occasional dark brown-black granular pigment deposits, likely hemosiderin or artifact
No caseous necrosis or definite multinucleated giant cells in this field
2615.describe_en: Section shows a poorly demarcated aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm and oval vesicular nuclei, admixed with numerous small lymphocytes. Scattered coarse dark granular pigment is present. There is no necrosis, and multinucleated giant cells are not definitively identified in this field. The tinctorial quality suggests a Giemsa-type or faded hematoxylin stain, which limits cytoplasmic detail. Findings are consistent with non-necrotizing granulomatous inflammation, compatible with sarcoidosis once infection is excluded.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas typically have central caseous necrosis and acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain, neither of which is present here.
Histoplasma shows small intracellular yeasts within macrophages on GMS/PAS stains, which should be sought in any marrow granuloma.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with epithelioid histiocytes (Lennert type)
ddx.vs: Lennert lymphoma contains atypical small-to-medium T cells with irregular nuclei between histiocytic clusters and shows clonal TCR rearrangement.

1271.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一群中型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質豐富淡藍、邊緣不規則並有細小突起，核圓、染色質中等凝集且可見明顯核仁；與右側染色質塊狀的正常小淋巴球相比，這種有核仁又帶毛邊的細胞提示毛細胞白血病變異型。
features: Cluster of medium-to-large lymphoid cells with abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Irregular cytoplasmic outlines with fine, short projections
Round nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and a visible nucleolus in several cells
Adjacent granulated cell (top center) and a separate small cell with clumped chromatin for size comparison
Background of normochromic red cells and sparse platelets
1271.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small cluster of medium to large lymphoid cells with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and irregular, finely projected margins. The nuclei are round with moderately condensed chromatin, and several cells show a distinct nucleolus. A granulated cell lies adjacent to the cluster, and a separate small cell with clumped chromatin is present for comparison. The combination of hairy cytoplasmic outlines with prominent nucleoli favors hairy cell leukemia variant over classic hairy cell leukemia.
