Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia variant, pending flow cytometry (CD103+, CD25-negative) and BRAF V600E testing.

ddx.vs: Classic hairy cells lack a conspicuous nucleolus, have oval to bean-shaped nuclei and are CD25+/annexin A1+/BRAF V600E-positive; they present with monocytopenia rather than leukocytosis.
Prolymphocytes have a prominent nucleolus but scant cytoplasm with smooth, non-villous borders.
SMZL cells are smaller with scant cytoplasm, polar villi and no prominent nucleolus, and are CD103-negative.
MCL cells have scant cytoplasm and irregular nuclei, and are CD5+ with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression.

1207.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中，許多膜性/細胞質陽性的棕色細胞散佈於間質並形成小群聚，形態符合漿細胞標記（多為 CD138）凸顯增加的漿細胞；中央一個淡色、無細胞的圓形沉積物可能為類澱粉，但單憑此染色無法確定。
features: Hypercellular marrow with numerous scattered positive cells and small clusters in an interstitial distribution
Membranous and cytoplasmic brown staining pattern compatible with a plasma cell marker
A pale, acellular, round homogeneous deposit in the center of the core
Positive staining of cells lining a few stromal/vascular structures (upper left)
Adjacent bone trabecula and fat without specific staining
1207.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostain shows numerous positive cells scattered interstitially and in small clusters throughout a cellular marrow; the membranous pattern is compatible with a plasma cell marker such as CD138, although the antibody is not specified. A pale, acellular, round homogeneous deposit is present centrally, which could represent amyloid but requires Congo red staining for confirmation. Kappa/lambda staining is needed to establish clonality and quantify the plasma cell burden. Findings are suggestive of an increased plasma cell population in a patient with amyloidosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are polytypic by kappa/lambda staining and usually perivascular, whereas clonal plasma cells show light-chain restriction.
Myeloma usually shows sheets or large nodules of plasma cells (often >10% and diffuse), rather than scattered interstitial cells and small clusters.
Gelatinous transformation is pale-staining interstitial ground substance with fat atrophy and is Congo red-negative, unlike amyloid.

1207.stain: IHC (plasma cell marker, antigen not specified)

1143.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中箭頭所指的巨核細胞，核只分成兩個分開的圓形核葉（雙核/低分葉），而非正常的多葉核，屬發育不良巨核細胞（dysplastic megakaryocyte），常見於 MDS。
features: Megakaryocytes with two separate, round, non-lobulated nuclei (arrows)
Moderate-size cells with abundant homogeneous gray-blue cytoplasm
Absence of normal multilobated nuclear configuration
Background cellular aspirate with maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors
Scattered fat vacuoles in the particle
1143.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular background of maturing hematopoietic elements with several megakaryocytes (arrows) that contain two widely separated round nuclear lobes rather than a normal single multilobated nucleus. The megakaryocytes have abundant homogeneous gray-blue cytoplasm. These binucleated/separated-lobe forms represent dysplastic megakaryocytes. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia, as seen in myelodysplastic neoplasms; at least 10% dysplastic megakaryocytes among 30 evaluated are required to define significant dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are near-promyelocyte size with a single small hypolobated nucleus, not two separate large round nuclei.

ddx.dx: Hypolobated megakaryocytes of MDS with isolated del(5q)
ddx.vs: 5q- megakaryocytes typically have a single non-lobated or bilobed eccentric nucleus rather than two separate nuclei; karyotype separates them.
Osteoclasts contain multiple (often many) separate uniform nuclei each with a nucleolus and granular cytoplasm.
Occasional abnormal forms occur in reactive states, but they are fewer than 10% and not accompanied by multilineage dysplasia or clonal abnormalities.

exam.answer_en: Dysplastic megakaryocytes — megakaryocytes with two or more widely separated round nuclear lobes ('pawn ball' forms), as seen in MDS
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭問「這些巨核細胞哪裡異常？」答核分離成數個不相連的圓形核（separated nuclear lobes），而非正常相連的多葉核。
巨核細胞 dysplasia 形態：micromegakaryocytes（最具特異性）、hypolobated 小巨核細胞、多個分離圓核（pawn ball）；後者也可見於化療後或 HIV。
判定有意義 dysplasia：該系列 ≥10% 細胞異常；巨核細胞建議至少評估 30 顆（note 已提）。單看 dysplasia 不足以診斷 MDS，需排除 B12/葉酸缺乏、銅缺乏、藥物、酒精。
MDS 診斷需結合持續血球減少、芽細胞比例、cytogenetics 與 NGS；WHO 5th 依 del(5q)、SF3B1、biallelic TP53 等定義遺傳型別。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 osteoclast 混淆；osteoclast 為多個分開但大小一致的圓核、胞質粉紅帶顆粒且常在骨小樑旁，dysplastic megakaryocyte 核數較少、胞質灰藍均質並位於骨髓造血區。

quiz.q: 圖中巨核細胞的核呈數個分離的圓形核葉，這屬於哪一系列的發育不良？判定有意義的比例門檻是多少？
quiz.a: 巨核細胞系列（megakaryocytic dysplasia）；≥10% 巨核細胞異常

1079.recognize_zh: 多顆核偏位的漿細胞，細胞質淡藍灰色，內含大量粗大紅紫色嗜天青顆粒（Snapper-Schneid顆粒），顆粒聚集在細胞質一側。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and coarse clock-face chromatin
Moderate to abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with perinuclear pallor
Numerous coarse reddish-purple azurophilic granules clustered in the cytoplasm
Some granules released into the background from disrupted cells
Aspirate background with fat vacuoles, small lymphocytes, and red cells
1079.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, and grey-blue cytoplasm. Many of the plasma cells contain abundant coarse reddish-purple azurophilic cytoplasmic granules, consistent with Snapper-Schneid granules; scattered granules are also present free in the background. Fat vacuoles and small lymphocytes are noted. Findings show azurophilic granulated plasma cells as seen in plasma cell neoplasms; correlation with plasma cell percentage and clonality studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Promyelocytes have central to slightly eccentric nuclei with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are MPO positive, lacking clock-face chromatin.
Mast cell granules are dark purple-black, metachromatic, and fill the cytoplasm over a central round nucleus.
Eosinophilic granules are orange-red, larger, and uniform, and the cells have granulocytic rather than plasmacytoid nuclei.

4087.recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 下組織被瀰漫、黏著成片的中至大型腫瘤細胞取代，細胞質淡染或透亮、核圓至卵圓帶小核仁，間以纖細膠原條索；此倍率只能判定為大細胞淋巴瘤，間變型態與 B/T 系別需高倍與免疫染色確認。
features: Diffuse sheet-like proliferation of medium-to-large atypical cells effacing normal architecture
Cells appear cohesive with moderate pale to clear cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Round to oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli; occasional larger irregular nuclei
Delicate intersecting collagen/vascular strands and scattered mitoses
Denser small lymphocytes at the right edge
4087.describe_en: H&E section at intermediate power shows diffuse effacement by sheets of cohesive medium-to-large atypical cells with moderate pale to clear cytoplasm, round to oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli, separated by delicate collagenous and vascular strands. Scattered mitotic figures are seen, and residual small lymphocytes are present at the periphery. Marked nuclear pleomorphism is not well appreciated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a large cell lymphoma with a cohesive growth pattern; immunohistochemistry (CD20, PAX5, CD30, ALK, CD3, keratin) is needed to establish the anaplastic variant of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and exclude ALCL and carcinoma.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows hallmark horseshoe-nucleus cells with sinusoidal growth but lacks B-cell antigens, requiring CD20/PAX5 to separate.
The cohesive pattern mimics carcinoma, which is distinguished by keratin positivity and CD45 negativity.
Centroblastic DLBCL is less cohesive with multiple membrane-bound nucleoli and lacks the bizarre pleomorphic cells of the anaplastic variant.
Seminoma has clear cells with fibrous septa and lymphocytes but is OCT3/4 and SALL4-positive.

4215.recognize_zh: 淋巴結免疫染色中，瀰漫分布的中型淋巴球絕大多數呈核染色陽性，僅高內皮小靜脈與基質細胞陰性，顯示結構被單一 T 細胞群取代；抗體名稱未標示，需對照其他染色與 HTLV-1 才能判讀 ATLL。
features: Diffuse sheet-like lymphoid infiltrate effacing nodal architecture at low-intermediate power
Majority of medium-sized lymphoid cells show brown, predominantly nuclear staining of variable intensity
Negative high endothelial venules and stromal cells scattered through the infiltrate
No residual follicular pattern evident
Specific antibody not indicated; nuclear pattern (e.g., FOXP3, Ki-67 or a transcription factor) cannot be further specified from the image
4215.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node (antibody not labeled) shows diffuse effacement by medium-sized lymphoid cells, the majority of which display predominantly nuclear staining of variable intensity, while high endothelial venules and stromal elements are negative. No residual follicles are appreciated. The image documents a diffuse, immunoreactive lymphoid population but does not by itself establish lineage; in the context of HTLV-1 infection and a CD4+/CD25+ T-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with nodal involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS can look identical and is separated by absence of HTLV-1 integration and usually lack of diffuse CD25/FOXP3 expression.
AITL shows arborizing HEVs with expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks and TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13) in a polymorphous background.
cHL has scattered CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells in a reactive background rather than a monotonous diffuse infiltrate.

4151.recognize_zh: 小型退化的生發中心內可見大型空泡狀核的濾泡樹突細胞與嗜酸性玻璃樣基質，外圍小淋巴球呈同心圓「洋蔥皮」（onion-skin）排列，這是透明血管型 Castleman 病的特徵。
features: Small regressed germinal center with prominent follicular dendritic cells (large vesicular nuclei)
Eosinophilic hyaline material within and around the atretic germinal center
Concentric onion-skin layering of small mantle-zone lymphocytes
Hyalinized small vessels in the follicle and interfollicular region
No sheets of atypical cells; small mature lymphocytes predominate
4151.describe_en: Lymph node section shows an atretic germinal center composed predominantly of follicular dendritic cells with enlarged vesicular nuclei and eosinophilic hyaline stroma. The germinal center is surrounded by an expanded mantle zone in which small lymphocytes are arranged in concentric onion-skin layers. Hyalinized vessels are present nearby, and no cytologically atypical population is identified. Findings are consistent with hyaline-vascular (unicentric) Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: FL has crowded neoplastic follicles with attenuated mantles and BCL2-positive germinal centers rather than atretic FDC-rich centers with onion-skin mantles.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL mantles are composed of cyclin D1/SOX11-positive monotonous cells, not polyclonal small lymphocytes.
HIV lymphadenitis has follicle lysis with hemorrhage and clinical HIV infection, often with plasmacytosis rather than expanded concentric mantles.
AITL shows regressed follicles with atypical clear T cells, expanded FDC meshworks outside follicles and PD1/CXCL13 expression.

exam.answer_en: Hyaline-vascular Castleman disease — regressed germinal center with prominent FDCs, hyaline material and onion-skin mantle zone
pearls_zh: 考法：指著萎縮生發中心與外圍同心圓套區，問診斷與形態名詞；答 hyaline-vascular Castleman disease、onion-skin、regressed germinal center。
Hyaline-vascular 型多為 unicentric（UCD），常無全身症狀，手術完整切除通常可治癒。
IHC：CD21/CD23 顯示 FDC 網絡擴張或變形；cyclin D1 陰性可排除 mantle cell lymphoma 的 mantle zone pattern。
FDC 增生明顯者需留意少數可衍生 follicular dendritic cell sarcoma；多發性（MCD）要檢 HHV-8（LANA-1）與 HIV。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 mantle cell lymphoma（mantle zone pattern）或 follicular lymphoma：Castleman 的套區為小成熟淋巴球、cyclin D1 陰性、生發中心萎縮且有玻璃樣血管。

quiz.q: 圖中套區小淋巴球同心圓排列的描述名詞是？
quiz.a: Onion-skin pattern（洋蔥皮樣）

3895.recognize_zh: 低倍腹水細胞離心抹片中大多是胞質泡沫狀的巨噬細胞，但其中穿插著一群胞質深藍、核偏位的細胞（漿細胞），部分成小團出現，在腹水中出現這種細胞群應懷疑骨髓瘤侵犯。
features: Predominance of large foamy, vacuolated macrophages with reniform nuclei
Scattered and small clusters of cells with dense deep-blue cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei (plasma cells)
Occasional small lymphocytes and neutrophils
Clean background with rare red cells; fine nuclear detail limited at low power
3895.describe_en: Low-power cytospin of ascitic fluid shows a cellular specimen composed predominantly of foamy vacuolated macrophages, among which are scattered and loosely clustered cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei consistent with plasma cells. Small lymphocytes and occasional neutrophils are present. Nuclear detail of the plasma cells is limited at this magnification. In a patient with plasma cell myeloma, findings are suggestive of myelomatous involvement of ascites; CD138 with kappa/lambda staining or flow cytometry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are sparse, mature and polytypic, while myelomatous effusions contain more numerous, often atypical, light chain-restricted plasma cells.
Mesothelial cells have central nuclei, dense cytoplasm with a pale peripheral skirt and 'windows' between cells, and are calretinin-positive.
PEL cells are large immunoblastic/plasmablastic cells with prominent nucleoli and are HHV-8 positive.

3639.recognize_zh: 這個視野有好幾顆淋巴球，核上有溝紋、凹陷或折疊，呈腦迴狀（cerebriform），細胞質少、淡藍色；混在正常中性球和嗜酸球之間，符合 Sézary 症候群的周邊血。
features: Multiple atypical lymphocytes of small to intermediate size with convoluted, grooved, or cleft (cerebriform) nuclei
Dense chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
Admixed normal segmented neutrophil and a partially visible eosinophil
Background RBCs with marked crenation (echinocytic artifact)
3639.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several atypical lymphocytes of small to intermediate size with convoluted, grooved, and cleft nuclei, dense chromatin, and scant pale-blue agranular cytoplasm. A segmented neutrophil and a partially visible eosinophil are also present. Red cells show crenation artifact. Findings are consistent with circulating Sézary cells; flow cytometric enumeration of CD4+CD7- or CD4+CD26- T cells is recommended to meet diagnostic criteria for Sézary syndrome.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells have deeply lobulated petal-like nuclei, patients are HTLV-1 seropositive, and the cells are usually CD25-bright.
T-PLL cells show a prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs and are often TCL1-positive with inv(14)/t(14;14).
Reactive cells show polyclonal T-cell receptor gene rearrangement and no aberrant loss of CD7 or CD26.

exam.answer_en: Sézary syndrome, peripheral blood — multiple small-to-intermediate lymphocytes with convoluted cerebriform nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：在混有正常中性球與嗜酸球的視野中，考官要你挑出核有溝紋、折疊的淋巴球並命名為 Sézary cell。
診斷需搭配臨床紅皮症與血液克隆性 T 細胞；flow 以 CD4+CD7− 或 CD4+CD26− 族群定量，並做 TCR 基因重組確認克隆性。
MF/SS 的 TNMB 分期中 B2 代表高血液腫瘤負荷，Sézary syndrome 即屬 B2 血液侵犯。
形態計數 Sézary 細胞主觀性高，現行診斷較倚重 flow cytometry 定量，而非單看抹片。
exam.pitfall_zh: 反應性淋巴球偶有核裂痕，易誤判為 Sézary cell；關鍵是需多顆細胞呈一致的腦迴狀核，並以 flow 證實 CD7/CD26 丟失的克隆性 CD4+ 族群。

quiz.q: 此視野中核有溝紋、呈腦迴狀的淋巴球是什麼？MF/SS 分期中周邊血高腫瘤負荷屬於哪一級 B？
quiz.a: Sézary cells；B2。

3703.recognize_zh: 組織切片中是一大片瀰漫浸潤、黏合性差的中大型腫瘤細胞，核卵圓到梭形、大小不一，染色質細、可見核分裂與少數多形性大細胞；在 AML 移植後復發的病史下，符合白血病浸潤（骨髓肉瘤型態）。僅憑 H&E 無法確定骨髓系來源，需要免疫染色。
features: Diffuse sheet of medium-to-large mononuclear cells with ovoid to spindled nuclei in a vaguely streaming pattern
Moderate nuclear pleomorphism with fine chromatin and occasional small nucleoli
Scattered large, bizarre hyperchromatic cells and mitotic figures
Scant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Few interspersed eosinophilic cells/RBCs; no normal organ architecture preserved in this field
3703.describe_en: Section at intermediate power shows a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of medium-to-large cells with ovoid to spindled nuclei, fine chromatin, and scant cytoplasm arranged in a vaguely streaming pattern. There is moderate pleomorphism with scattered large hyperchromatic cells and mitoses, and no residual normal architecture is seen. The morphology is not lineage-specific. In the clinical context of recurrent AML after stem cell transplant, findings are suggestive of leukemic infiltration (myeloid sarcoma), to be confirmed by immunohistochemistry for CD34, CD117, MPO, CD68/lysozyme, and exclusion of carcinoma, melanoma, and sarcoma.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma or PTLD
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are round with vesicular chromatin and are CD20/PAX5-positive, and PTLD is often EBER-positive, whereas myeloid sarcoma expresses MPO, CD117, or lysozyme.
Sarcomas lack hematopoietic markers (CD45, CD43, MPO) and often show a fibrillary or myxoid stroma.

ddx.dx: Metastatic poorly differentiated carcinoma or melanoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma is keratin-positive and melanoma is S100/SOX10-positive, while both are CD45- and MPO-negative.
BPDCN is CD4+/CD56+/CD123+/TCF4+ and MPO-negative.

3447.recognize_zh: 兩顆中性球的細胞質內可見淡紫色、帶中央顆粒的血小板（下方那顆最明顯，邊緣處包著數個血小板），背景另有小團血小板聚集，是中性球吞噬血小板的影像。
features: Two segmented neutrophils containing platelet-sized granular purple bodies in the cytoplasm
Lower-center neutrophil shows several engulfed platelets at the periphery and a pale vacuolated area
Small platelet clumps in the background
Red cells normochromic with occasional dark refractile debris overlying a red cell
No toxic granulation or Döhle bodies evident
3447.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells and small scattered platelet clumps. Two segmented neutrophils contain platelet-sized granular purple bodies within their cytoplasm; the neutrophil in the lower center shows several engulfed platelets near its margin with a pale, vacuolated cytoplasmic area. There is no toxic granulation, and the red cell overlying dark refractile particle is most likely debris. Findings are consistent with neutrophil phagocytosis of platelets, an in vitro EDTA-related phenomenon associated with pseudothrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: Satellitism shows platelets adhering around the outer neutrophil membrane rather than enclosed within the cytoplasm.
Organisms are uniform in shape (cocci, yeast with halo, or basophilic berry-like morulae) and lack the pale granulomere-hyalomere structure of platelets.
Hemophagocytosis in marrow involves macrophages engulfing red cells, platelets and nucleated cells, whereas here circulating neutrophils ingest only platelets in vitro.

3383.recognize_zh: 分葉中性球細胞質周邊有細小淡藍色斑塊（Döhle-like 包涵體），沒有毒性顆粒；旁邊有小淋巴球作為大小對照，右上角可見部分巨大血小板，符合 May-Hegglin anomaly。
features: Segmented neutrophil with subtle small pale blue cytoplasmic inclusions at the periphery
Absence of toxic granulation or vacuolization
Small lymphocyte with scant blue cytoplasm for size comparison
Partially visible large platelet/granular cell at upper right corner
Normocytic red cells with rouleaux-free distribution
3383.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil with small, subtle pale blue cytoplasmic inclusions near the cell periphery, without toxic granulation or vacuoles, next to a small mature lymphocyte. A large platelet is partially visible at the upper right corner. Red cells are normocytic. In the appropriate context of macrothrombocytopenia, the findings are consistent with MYH9-related disorder (May-Hegglin anomaly); the inclusions in this particular cell are small and would be better appreciated alongside additional neutrophils or MYH9 immunofluorescence.

ddx.vs: Reactive Döhle bodies accompany toxic granulation and vacuolization and are not associated with giant platelets.
Chediak-Higashi shows giant coarse azurophilic or gray-purple granules in granulocytes rather than pale blue amorphous inclusions.
Alder-Reilly shows dense, dark purple granules throughout the cytoplasm of all leukocytes without blue inclusions or platelet enlargement.

exam.answer_en: MYH9-related disorder (May-Hegglin anomaly) — subtle pale blue Döhle-like inclusions in a neutrophil lacking toxic granulation
pearls_zh: 考法：包涵體細小不明顯，考官會問「還需要看什麼才能確診？」，答：是否多數中性球都有包涵體、血小板大小與數量、家族史。
MYH9 包涵體在光顯下可能很淡，中性球 anti-MYH9 免疫螢光看異常聚集點是較敏感的篩檢方式，最終可做 MYH9 基因檢測。
其他遺傳性白血球顆粒異常：Alder-Reilly（mucopolysaccharidoses，深紫粗顆粒）、Chédiak-Higashi（LYST 突變，巨大顆粒、部分白化與反覆感染）。
臨床重點：避免誤診 ITP 而做不必要的免疫抑制或脾切除；需追蹤聽力、腎功能與白內障。
exam.pitfall_zh: 包涵體淡而小時易被忽略而誤診為 ITP；應在多顆中性球中尋找邊界較清楚的淡藍包涵體，並注意抹片中是否有大血小板。

quiz.q: 要確認此中性球包涵體屬於 MYH9-related disorder，可做哪一項檢查？
quiz.a: 中性球 MYH9 免疫螢光染色（或 MYH9 基因檢測）

3255.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中，含粗大橘紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球與嗜酸性骨髓細胞明顯增多，占據視野很大比例，部分混有深紫色未成熟顆粒，另有含空泡的單核細胞，呈現嗜酸性球增多的骨髓像。
features: Markedly increased eosinophils and eosinophilic myelocytes/metamyelocytes with orange-red granules
Some immature eosinophils with admixed dark purple granules
Vacuolated monocytoid/histiocytic cells scattered in the field
Small mature lymphocytes and occasional granulocytic precursors
Aspirate particle edge with fat space at center
3255.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle-adjacent area with a striking increase in eosinophils at all stages of maturation, including myelocytes and metamyelocytes with coarse orange-red granules and occasional immature forms with admixed dark purple granules. Scattered vacuolated monocytoid cells, small lymphocytes and other granulocytic precursors are present, and blasts are not conspicuously increased. Findings are consistent with marrow eosinophilia; reactive versus neoplastic etiology requires clinical correlation and cytogenetic/molecular testing.

ddx.vs: These cannot be separated morphologically and require FISH or molecular testing for the defining fusion genes.
CEL requires a clonal abnormality or increased blasts (>2% PB or 5-19% BM) after exclusion of reactive and defined genetic causes.
Inv(16) AML has increased blasts and monocytic cells with abnormal eosinophils bearing large basophilic granules.
This variant shows a morphologically reactive marrow eosinophilia driven by an aberrant T-cell population (e.g., CD3-CD4+) detectable by flow cytometry.

2871.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片：多顆大型紅血球系前驅細胞的核呈細點狀開放染色質，但細胞質已偏灰紫（血紅素化），典型的核質發育不同步；左下可見多葉狀紅血球系核。
features: Large megaloblasts with finely stippled, open chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant basophilic to gray-lilac cytoplasm indicating asynchronous maturation
Polychromatic megaloblast with pink-tinged cytoplasm but immature nucleus
Erythroid precursor with lobulated/budding nucleus (left)
Eosinophil myelocyte and a small mature lymphocyte for size comparison
2871.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow aspirate shows numerous megaloblasts, which are larger than normal erythroid precursors and have finely stippled, open chromatin. Their cytoplasm ranges from basophilic to polychromatic, so nuclear maturation lags behind cytoplasmic hemoglobinization. Occasional erythroid precursors show nuclear lobulation. Compared with the adjacent small lymphocyte, the megaloblasts are strikingly enlarged. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: Normoblasts show progressive chromatin condensation in step with cytoplasmic hemoglobinization, without enlargement or open chromatin.
MDS lacks response to vitamin replacement and shows dysplasia in other lineages and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
Parvovirus shows giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions and absence of later erythroid stages.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic erythropoiesis — enlarged megaloblasts with finely stippled open chromatin and asynchronous cytoplasmic maturation, dwarfing an adjacent lymphocyte
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會要你用旁邊的小 lymphocyte 當尺規比較大小，指出紅系前驅明顯變大、染色質細緻「篩孔狀」，並問是 megaloblast 還是 normoblast。
核分葉/出芽的紅系前驅（nuclear budding）與 Howell-Jolly body 在 megaloblastic anemia 常見，不等於 MDS。
病因分類：B12 缺乏（pernicious anemia、胃切除、metformin、素食）、folate 缺乏（酒精、營養、懷孕、溶血需求增加）、藥物（DHFR inhibitor 如 pyrimethamine、methotrexate；purine/pyrimidine 拮抗劑）。
Pernicious anemia 相關檢查：anti-intrinsic factor antibody（特異性高）、anti-parietal cell antibody（敏感但不特異）。
治療反應：補充後數日內網狀紅血球上升；嚴重病人補充初期需注意 hypokalemia。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 megaloblast 誤認為 proerythroblast/blast 而疑為 leukemia：megaloblast 細胞質已有 polychromasia（血紅素化）而核仍不成熟，且可見各階段巨大紅系細胞連續存在。

quiz.q: 與旁邊小 lymphocyte 比較，圖中大型、染色質細緻篩孔狀且細胞質偏 polychromatic 的細胞為何？
quiz.a: Megaloblast（megaloblastic erythroid precursor）

2743.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中數顆中型淋巴細胞，細胞質中等量且明顯嗜鹼性，核圓或有凹陷，右上一顆可見清楚核仁；中型、帶核仁與嗜鹼性細胞質的淋巴細胞符合前淋巴球，配合臨床為 T-PLL。
features: Intermediate-sized lymphoid cells, about 1.5-2 times a red cell diameter
Moderate rim of distinctly basophilic cytoplasm
Round to indented nuclei, one cell with a notched nucleus
Moderately condensed chromatin with a visible nucleolus in at least one cell
Cytoplasmic blebs subtle in this field; red cells unremarkable
2743.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with a moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm, round to indented nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and a discernible nucleolus in at least one cell. Cytoplasmic blebs are subtle in this field. Red cells are unremarkable. These prolymphocyte-like cells are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia in the appropriate context; immunophenotyping and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement analysis are required.

ddx.vs: B-prolymphocytes have a single prominent central nucleolus with more condensed peripheral chromatin and express B-cell antigens; lineage requires flow cytometry.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous, often larger with abundant cytoplasm that indents around red cells.
ATLL cells show polylobated flower nuclei, CD25 positivity and HTLV-1 infection.

2679.recognize_zh: 淋巴球核呈腎形凹陷，箭頭處凹陷內的細胞質有一小段透明、不著色的棒狀結構，這是結晶包涵體的負像；核染色質粗、細胞質少，符合惡性成熟淋巴球。
features: Lymphocyte with high N:C ratio and indented nucleus
Coarse chromatin with irregular pale areas; nucleoli not evident
Scant pale cytoplasm with a thin rim
Short colorless crystalline rod within the nuclear indentation (arrow)
Normochromic red cells; low-resolution enlarged image
2679.describe_en: High-power, digitally enlarged view of a peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocyte with a high N:C ratio, an indented nucleus with coarse chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm. A short, unstained, rod-like crystalline inclusion lies within the cytoplasm in the nuclear indentation (arrow). No granules or Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with a crystalline inclusion in a malignant lymphocyte, as seen in CLL and related B-cell neoplasms; image resolution limits evaluation of chromatin detail.

ddx.vs: Auer rods take a pink-purple stain and occur in blasts with open chromatin and nucleoli, unlike this clear inclusion in a mature cell.
Artifacts extend beyond the cell or change shape across fields, whereas true crystals are intracytoplasmic with straight edges.

ddx.dx: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma cell with Dutcher body
ddx.vs: Dutcher bodies are round PAS-positive pale inclusions overlying the nucleus rather than straight colorless rods in the cytoplasm.

2103.recognize_zh: 這是一張 PCR 洋菜膠電泳圖，不是型態學影像：陽性對照（P）與骨髓移植後 0、5、7、17、26、38 個月的檢體都在 120 bp 處出現同一條亮帶，陰性對照（N）沒有，表示標的序列在移植後持續可測得。
features: Ethidium bromide-stained agarose gel photograph; non-morphologic
Positive control (P) shows a strong band at 120 bp; negative control (N) is blank
Samples at 0, 5, 7, 17, 26 and 38 months after BMT all show a band of the same 120 bp size
Faint smaller bands below the main product in several lanes, most likely primer-dimer or nonspecific products
Target sequence is not labeled on the figure; in the context of ATLL it presumably represents HTLV-1 proviral DNA or a clone-specific marker
2103.describe_en: Agarose gel electrophoresis of PCR products is shown with a positive control, a negative control, and serial post-transplant samples. A 120 bp amplicon matching the positive control is present at every time point from 0 to 38 months after bone marrow transplantation, while the negative control shows no product. Band intensity is roughly similar across time points, although this end-point assay is not quantitative. The target is not labeled in the image; in the setting of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, the findings indicate persistent detection of the target sequence (presumably HTLV-1 provirus) after transplantation.

2039.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結 H&E：上方與中央有大片淡粉紅、無結構的壞死區（caseous necrosis），周圍由淡染的類上皮組織球帶包圍，外圍是深藍色的淋巴組織，這是乾酪性肉芽腫（caseating granuloma），符合分枝桿菌感染。
features: Low-power lymph node with residual dark blue lymphoid parenchyma
Large pale eosinophilic, amorphous, acellular zones consistent with caseous necrosis
Palisading rim of pale epithelioid histiocytes around necrotic areas
Smaller pale epithelioid granuloma nodules within lymphoid tissue (right and left)
Perinodal fibroadipose tissue at the bottom edge
2039.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows partial effacement by large granulomas with central pale eosinophilic, amorphous, acellular caseous-type necrosis surrounded by a rim of epithelioid histiocytes. Smaller epithelioid granulomas are present within the residual lymphoid parenchyma. Multinucleated giant cells cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with necrotizing (caseating) granulomatous lymphadenitis, suggestive of mycobacterial infection; acid-fast stain and culture are recommended.

ddx.vs: Fungal granulomas can have identical necrosis and are distinguished by GMS/PAS demonstration of organisms.
Bartonella causes stellate suppurative granulomas with central neutrophils rather than homogeneous pink caseous necrosis.
Sarcoid granulomas are usually non-necrotizing and discrete, without large confluent areas of caseation.
Kikuchi shows paracortical apoptotic necrosis with karyorrhectic debris and histiocytes lacking well-formed epithelioid granulomas and neutrophils.

exam.answer_en: Necrotizing (caseating) granulomatous lymphadenitis, suggestive of mycobacterial infection — caseous necrosis rimmed by epithelioid histiocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍淋巴結問「中央淡粉紅無結構區是什麼壞死？周圍是什麼細胞？」答：caseous necrosis；epithelioid histiocytes（可有 Langhans giant cells）。
下一步：AFB 染色（Ziehl-Neelsen）、GMS/PAS 找黴菌，並送 culture 或 PCR；新鮮組織應保留一部分送培養。
乾酪性壞死鑑別：TB、NTM、histoplasmosis、coccidioidomycosis；中央有嗜中性球的 stellate suppurative granuloma 則提示 cat-scratch disease 或 tularemia。
免疫機轉：肉芽腫由 Th1 細胞分泌 IFN-γ 活化巨噬細胞形成；使用 TNF-α 抑制劑前需篩檢潛伏結核，因其會破壞肉芽腫維持。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 sarcoidosis：類肉瘤肉芽腫多為 non-necrotizing、緊密而分散；出現大片融合乾酪性壞死應優先排除感染，AFB 陰性也不能排除 TB。

quiz.q: 圖中大片淡粉紅色、無細胞結構的區域是什麼型態的壞死？最先要做哪個特殊染色？
quiz.a: Caseous necrosis；acid-fast（Ziehl-Neelsen）stain

1783.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中出現大量有核紅血球（箭頭所指為小而深染、細胞核固縮的正染性母紅血球），並伴隨多染性紅血球，符合胎兒母紅血球增多症（胎兒與新生兒溶血性疾病）的強烈紅血球生成反應。
features: Markedly increased nucleated red blood cells, mostly orthochromatic normoblasts with small dense pyknotic nuclei (arrows), some binucleate or paired
Occasional less mature polychromatophilic normoblasts with bluish-gray cytoplasm
Polychromasia with large bluish macrocytic red cells
Scattered small dense spherocyte-like red cells without central pallor
Increased leukocytes including neutrophils and myeloid precursors, as seen in neonatal blood
1783.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous nucleated red blood cells, predominantly orthochromatic normoblasts with small pyknotic nuclei (arrows), along with occasional polychromatophilic normoblasts. There is prominent polychromasia with occasional small dense red cells lacking central pallor. Neutrophils and occasional immature myeloid cells are present. Findings are consistent with a marked erythropoietic response to hemolysis, as seen in hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (erythroblastosis fetalis); correlation with direct antiglobulin test and maternal-fetal blood group serology is recommended.

ddx.dx: Hereditary spherocytosis presenting in the newborn
ddx.vs: Hereditary spherocytosis shows prominent spherocytes with a negative direct antiglobulin test and usually fewer circulating normoblasts.

ddx.dx: Congenital infection (e.g., CMV, syphilis) or hypoxic stress
ddx.vs: These can raise nucleated red cells but lack a positive DAT and are accompanied by thrombocytopenia or other clinical features rather than isolated hemolysis.
Transient abnormal myelopoiesis shows circulating megakaryoblasts or blasts rather than a predominantly erythroid normoblastemia.
Leukoerythroblastosis is accompanied by teardrop cells and left-shifted myeloid cells in the absence of brisk polychromasia and immune hemolysis.

exam.answer_en: Erythroblastosis fetalis (hemolytic disease of the fetus/newborn) — numerous circulating nucleated red cells with marked polychromasia
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭的小而深染核的細胞問「這是什麼？在新生兒血中大量出現代表什麼？」答 orthochromatic normoblast（有核紅血球），代表溶血引起的強烈紅血球生成。
必做檢查：新生兒 DAT（direct antiglobulin test）陽性、母親抗體篩檢與鑑定、母子 ABO/Rh 血型；嚴重度追蹤膽紅素與血紅素。
抗體：ABO 不合最常見但多輕微（抹片常見 spherocytes）；anti-D 最嚴重；anti-Kell 會抑制紅血球前驅細胞，網狀紅血球反而不高。
預防：RhD 陰性孕婦於懷孕約 28 週及產下 RhD 陽性嬰兒後 72 小時內給 anti-D immunoglobulin；Kleihauer-Betke 或流式估算胎兒母體出血量以調整劑量。
產前以胎兒中腦動脈收縮期最高流速（MCA-PSV）Doppler 評估胎兒貧血，嚴重時行子宮內輸血。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把正常新生兒血中少量有核紅血球當成病理；健康新生兒出生時也有 NRBC，但本圖數量明顯增加並伴隨多染性紅血球，需以 DAT 陽性確認免疫性溶血，並排除 hereditary spherocytosis（DAT 陰性）。

quiz.q: 新生兒血液抹片見大量箭頭所指細胞與多染性紅血球，第一個應做的血庫檢查是什麼？
quiz.a: Direct antiglobulin test（DAT, direct Coombs test），陽性支持母體抗體造成的 HDFN。

1719.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中一顆中性球的細胞質充滿粗大、深紫色的顆粒，比正常中性球的淡粉紅細顆粒明顯得多，符合毒性顆粒（toxic granulation）。
features: Segmented neutrophil with three nuclear lobes and condensed chromatin
Cytoplasm filled with coarse, dark purple-violet (azurophilic) granules evenly distributed
Granules are more prominent than the fine lilac granules of a normal neutrophil
No definite Dohle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuoles clearly identified
Crowded red cells in a thick area of the smear and scattered platelets
1719.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil whose cytoplasm contains abundant coarse, dark purple azurophilic granules in place of the normal fine lilac granules. Dohle bodies and vacuoles are not clearly seen. The red cells are crowded in this relatively thick area, so a neighboring normal neutrophil is not available for comparison. Findings are consistent with toxic granulation, a reactive change seen in infection, inflammation, or G-CSF therapy.

ddx.vs: Alder-Reilly granules are large and dark in all leukocytes, including lymphocytes and monocytes, and occur without clinical infection in mucopolysaccharidoses.
Overstaining darkens granules in all neutrophils uniformly and gives a blue cast to red cells and background.
Chediak-Higashi shows few giant, irregular fused granules rather than numerous uniform coarse granules.
Eosinophils have refractile orange-red granules with a bilobed nucleus, and basophils have very large blue-black granules obscuring the nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Toxic granulation — segmented neutrophil with coarse dark purple azurophilic granules replacing normal fine lilac granules
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指中性球問「細胞質有何變化？代表什麼？」答 toxic granulation，屬反應性變化，見於細菌感染/敗血症、發炎、G-CSF 治療、懷孕。
常一起出現的「toxic changes」：Döhle bodies、細胞質空泡（vacuolization，對敗血症較具特異性）、left shift。
機轉：快速生成時一級（嗜天青）顆粒成熟異常而保留嗜鹼性染色特性。
判讀需與同張片其他中性球比較並注意染色品質；染色過深時所有中性球顆粒都會變深。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Alder-Reilly anomaly；Alder-Reilly 為 mucopolysaccharidosis 相關，所有白血球（含淋巴球、單核球）都有粗大顆粒且與感染無關，毒性顆粒只見於中性球系。

quiz.q: 圖中中性球的粗大深紫顆粒稱為什麼？列出兩個常見原因。
quiz.a: Toxic granulation；細菌感染/敗血症、G-CSF 治療（亦可見於發炎、懷孕）。

1591.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆較大的白血球，核呈腎形／摺疊狀，染色質細緻呈花邊樣，細胞質量多、呈灰藍色（毛玻璃樣），無明顯顆粒或空泡，是正常單核球（monocyte）的典型外觀。
features: Large mononuclear cell, larger than a neutrophil
Kidney-shaped to folded nucleus with a deep indentation
Fine lacy chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate to abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with a ground-glass appearance and very fine granules
No cytoplasmic vacuoles; background red cells and platelets appear normal
1591.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single monocyte with a kidney-shaped, folded nucleus, lacy chromatin without nucleoli, and a moderate amount of gray-blue ground-glass cytoplasm. No vacuoles, coarse granules or Auer rods are present. The background red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a normal monocyte.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have denser chromatin and more basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around adjacent red cells, rather than lacy chromatin and gray ground-glass cytoplasm.
Promonocytes have more delicate chromatin with visible nucleoli and subtle nuclear folding, whereas this cell has mature condensed lacy chromatin and a well-formed fold.
Myeloid cells at these stages have pink cytoplasm with specific granules and more condensed chromatin, unlike this gray-blue agranular cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Normal monocyte — large cell, folded/reniform nucleus with lacy chromatin, abundant gray-blue ground-glass cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：指大顆白血球問名稱，需與 reactive lymphocyte、metamyelocyte 區分；重點是摺疊核加灰藍毛玻璃狀胞質。
細胞化學與 flow：nonspecific esterase（α-naphthyl butyrate）陽性且可被 NaF 抑制；成熟單核球 CD14、CD64、CD11b、CD36 陽性。
CMML 門檻（WHO 5th / ICC 2022）：持續性 monocyte ≥0.5×10^9/L 且佔白血球 ≥10%；考試常以單核球計數切入。
臨床上 monocytosis 見於慢性感染（TB、心內膜炎）、發炎性疾病、脾切除後與 CMML；急性骨髓抑制恢復期單核球常最先回升。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常被誤認為 reactive lymphocyte；後者胞質邊緣深藍、會貼著紅血球「裙擺」，核較圓不摺疊，染色質也較粗。

quiz.q: 這顆細胞是什麼？用哪個細胞化學染色可確認，且會被什麼抑制？
quiz.a: Monocyte；nonspecific esterase，被 NaF 抑制

119.recognize_zh: 淋巴結整體結構還在，有退化、類 Castleman 的濾泡（套區呈同心圓排列），但被膜下與皮質淋巴竇（sinus）裡塞滿大型漿母細胞樣（plasmablastic）細胞；這些細胞 HHV8（LANA）呈點狀核染色、EBER 陽性，B 細胞標記則多為陰性。
features: Large atypical cells distending subcapsular and cortical sinuses while overall nodal architecture is preserved
Tumor cells 3-5x a small lymphocyte, abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, distinct cell borders (plasmablastic/immunoblastic)
Round to irregular vesicular nuclei with prominent central nucleoli; occasional binucleate forms and mitoses
Regressed follicles with concentric mantle zones and depleted, vascularized germinal centers (Castleman-like)
Stippled nuclear HHV8/LANA-type staining and EBER ISH nuclear signal in the sinusoidal large cells
Large cells are negative for the membranous marker(s) that highlight background small lymphocytes; aberrant cytoplasmic staining with a T-cell-type marker (per case, CD3)
119.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show preserved overall architecture with numerous small follicles, some regressed with concentric mantle zones and hyalinized, vascular germinal centers (Castleman-like). The subcapsular and intermediate sinuses are distended by sheets and clusters of large, discohesive neoplastic cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, consistent with plasmablastic/immunoblastic morphology. By immunohistochemistry, the large cells lack the membranous markers expressed by background small lymphocytes, show strong cytoplasmic and nuclear staining with plasma-cell/activation-associated markers (per case, MUM1 and aberrant cytoplasmic CD3), and show stippled nuclear HHV8 (LANA-1) positivity; EBER in situ hybridization is positive. The individual IHC antibodies are not labeled on the images, so marker assignments rely on the case description. In an HIV-positive patient, findings are consistent with nodal involvement by extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: GLPD is HHV8+/EBER+ too, but its plasmablasts are confined to germinal centers in HIV-negative patients, whereas here large cells fill the sinuses in an HIV-positive patient.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive DLBCL, NOS (arising in multicentric Castleman disease)
ddx.vs: HHV8+ DLBCL is typically EBER-negative and IgM-lambda restricted with mantle-zone plasmablast aggregates, whereas EC-PEL is EBER-positive and shows sinusoidal growth with loss of B-cell and immunoglobulin expression.
Cytoplasmic CD3 and EBER positivity can mimic ENKTL, but ENKTL is HHV8/LANA-negative, CD56+ with cytotoxic granules, and angiocentric rather than sinusoidal.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or ALK+ large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Both share a plasmablastic immunophenotype and sinusoidal growth, but plasmablastic lymphoma is HHV8-negative and ALK+ LBCL shows granular cytoplasmic ALK, whereas this case shows nuclear LANA.

119.stain: H&E; IHC (incl. CD3, MUM1, HHV8/LANA); ISH: EBER
captions: Low-power H&E: lymph node with preserved architecture and numerous small follicles
H&E: large pale cells distending subcapsular and cortical sinuses beneath the capsule
H&E: sinus packed with large plasmablastic cells adjacent to fibrous capsule
H&E: regressed Castleman-like follicle next to a sinus filled with large atypical cells
High-power H&E: plasmablastic cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli
IHC (unlabeled membranous marker): small lymphocytes positive, large tumor cells negative
IHC (unlabeled nuclear marker): small background cells positive, sinusoidal large cells negative
IHC (likely CD3, per case): strong cytoplasmic staining of large cells plus background T cells
IHC (unlabeled membranous marker): background lymphocytes positive, sheets of large cells negative
IHC (likely MUM1, per case): nuclear/cytoplasmic staining of large cell clusters
IHC (unlabeled): strong cytoplasmic staining in large plasmablastic cells
EBER ISH: dark purple nuclear signal in a cluster of tumor cells
HHV8/LANA IHC, low power: positive cells confined to sinuses
HHV8/LANA IHC: stippled nuclear staining of sinusoidal tumor cells

55.recognize_zh: 真皮內有由上到下的結節狀至瀰漫性淋巴浸潤，混有殘存濾泡（CD21/CD23 樹突細胞網）與大量背景 T 細胞及組織球；關鍵在 ISH 顯示漿細胞輕鏈比例明顯偏向一側（一個輕鏈大量陽性、另一個僅零星），支持皮膚邊緣區淋巴瘤而非反應性增生。
features: Dense nodular to diffuse dermal lymphoid infiltrate extending into deep dermis and dissecting collagen bundles, with a thin uninvolved papillary zone
Heterogeneous cytology: small lymphocytes, marginal zone-type/monocytoid cells, scattered large immunoblast-like cells with vesicular chromatin, and histiocytes with pale vacuolated cytoplasm
Residual follicles highlighted by an expanded, partly disrupted follicular dendritic cell meshwork (membranous IHC)
Numerous membrane-positive lymphocytes on two IHC stains (B- and T-cell markers, not labeled) and a nuclear marker concentrated in follicle-like clusters
Scattered larger positive cells with membranous/Golgi staining on another unlabeled IHC, in keeping with reactive large immunoblasts
Light chain ISH: abundant positive plasma cells for one light chain versus only rare cells for the other, indicating a light chain-restricted plasmacytic population
55.describe_en: Skin punch biopsy shows a dense nodular and diffuse lymphoid infiltrate occupying the superficial and deep dermis, sparing the epidermis and dissecting between collagen bundles. The infiltrate is polymorphous, composed of small lymphocytes, marginal zone-type cells, histiocytes and scattered large transformed cells, with residual reactive follicles outlined by follicular dendritic cell meshworks. Immunohistochemistry (markers not labeled in the images) shows abundant B cells as well as a prominent background T-cell population, and scattered large immunoblasts. In situ hybridization for kappa and lambda demonstrates a markedly skewed light chain ratio among the plasma cells. Findings are consistent with cutaneous extranodal marginal zone lymphoma; systemic staging is recommended.

ddx.vs: It may show identical nodular infiltrates with follicles but the plasma cells are polytypic on kappa/lambda ISH, without an infiltrative sheet-like B-cell population.
It lacks residual follicles and light chain-restricted plasma cells, and its scattered large cells are neoplastic B cells rather than the reactive immunoblasts seen here among marginal zone cells.
It is composed of centrocytes and centroblasts with BCL6+ (often CD10+) cells extending outside follicles, rather than marginal zone cells with monotypic plasmacytic differentiation.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD4+ small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: The dominant atypical cells are PD-1+ CD4+ T cells with a clonal TCR, whereas here B cells predominate with monotypic plasma cells.

captions: IHC (marker unlabeled): numerous membrane-positive lymphocytes in the superficial dermis beneath the epidermis
IHC (marker unlabeled): dense sheet of membrane-positive lymphoid cells in the dermis
Nuclear IHC (marker unlabeled): positive cells concentrated in follicle-like clusters with scattered positive cells between
FDC IHC (CD21/CD23-type pattern): expanded, partly disrupted dendritic meshworks around follicles
IHC (marker unlabeled): scattered large positive cells with membranous and dot-like staining, consistent with immunoblasts
H&E low power: dense nodular and diffuse lymphoid infiltrate throughout the dermis
H&E: polymorphous infiltrate with histiocytes around a hair follicle infundibulum
H&E high power: mixture of small lymphocytes, larger vesicular cells and vacuolated histiocytes
Light chain ISH: abundant positive plasma cells
Opposite light chain ISH: only rare positive cells, indicating light chain restriction

3575.recognize_zh: 單顆中性球的核呈 C 字形、未分葉的帶狀，但染色質已明顯粗糙凝集，與核型成熟度不一致（核低分葉），胞質中顆粒偏粗；這種核成熟不同步的表現可作為顆粒球發育不良（dysgranulopoiesis）的線索，但單一細胞不足以下診斷。
features: Single mature-sized neutrophil with a C-shaped, non-segmented (band-like) nucleus
Coarsely clumped, mature chromatin disproportionate to the lack of segmentation (nuclear hyposegmentation)
Cytoplasm with relatively coarse purple granules
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis; small platelet at lower right
3575.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a C-shaped, non-segmented nucleus containing coarsely clumped, mature-appearing chromatin, a nuclear-maturation mismatch suggestive of hyposegmentation. The cytoplasm contains relatively coarse granules, and hypogranularity is not evident. The surrounding red cells and platelet are unremarkable. In isolation this cell could represent a normal band form; hyposegmented neutrophils with clumped chromatin, when numerous (at least 10% of neutrophils), support dysgranulopoiesis as seen in myelodysplastic neoplasms.

ddx.vs: Normal bands have less condensed chromatin consistent with their maturation stage, and their frequency is not increased.
Pelger-Huët affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with bilobed or round nuclei and normal granulation, in an otherwise healthy patient.
Drug-related change is morphologically similar and is separated by medication history and reversibility after withdrawal.
Toxic neutrophils show coarse granules with Döhle bodies and vacuoles but normal nuclear segmentation.

61047.recognize_zh: 箭頭指向一個約 2–3 µm、位於紅血球旁的細胞外小體，可見藍紫色核與旁邊一個深色點狀構造（疑為動基體 kinetoplast），符合游離的利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（amastigote）；本視野細胞稀疏，未見巨噬細胞內聚集的蟲體，解讀受限。
features: Arrowed tiny extracellular oval body (about 2-3 um, much smaller than a red cell) adjacent to erythrocytes
Body shows a purple nucleus with an adjacent small dark rod/dot suggestive of a kinetoplast
Second dark blue inclusion superimposed on a red cell at lower left, of uncertain nature (possible organism or overlying platelet)
Mononuclear cell at right with basophilic cytoplasm and a few azurophilic granules
Sparse cellularity with red cells showing central pallor; no parasitized macrophage in this field
61047.describe_en: Smear from the provided bone marrow aspirate shows sparse cellularity with scattered red cells and a mononuclear cell containing a few azurophilic granules. The arrow highlights a small extracellular oval body, much smaller than a red cell, with a nucleus and an adjacent dark punctate structure suggestive of a kinetoplast, compatible with a Leishmania amastigote. A second dark inclusion overlying a red cell is of uncertain significance. Intracellular amastigotes within macrophages are not seen in this field, and a single organism at this resolution is not definitive. Findings are suggestive of Leishmania bodies; review of additional fields for parasitized macrophages, culture, or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are similar in size but have a clear halo and lack a kinetoplast; GMS/PAS stains the fungal wall.

ddx.dx: Platelet or platelet fragment overlying a red cell
ddx.vs: Platelets show granular purple centers without a separate nucleus and bar-shaped kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a single central nucleus and no kinetoplast.
T. marneffei yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and lack a kinetoplast.

exam.answer_en: Suggestive of Leishmania amastigote (BM aspirate) — tiny extracellular body with nucleus and adjacent kinetoplast-like dot; no parasitized macrophage in field
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭處 2–3 µm 的小體，問名稱與辨識依據；答 Leishmania amastigote（LD body），關鍵是核旁的棒狀 kinetoplast。
Visceral leishmaniasis（kala-azar，L. donovani／L. infantum）由白蛉傳播，典型表現為發燒、明顯脾腫大、全血球低下與多株高γ球蛋白血症。
診斷：骨髓抽吸找巨噬細胞內 amastigotes（脾抽吸敏感度最高但出血風險大），可加做 PCR、培養；rK39 抗原血清學快篩常用於流行區。
臨床連結：visceral leishmaniasis 是續發性 HLH 的可治療病因；治療常用 liposomal amphotericin B。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易與 Histoplasma 或疊在紅血球上的血小板混淆；Histoplasma 有透明暈但無 kinetoplast，血小板則無獨立核與棒狀 kinetoplast。單一游離小體證據有限，應找巨噬細胞內聚集蟲體。

quiz.q: Leishmania amastigote 與 Histoplasma 酵母在抹片上的關鍵區分構造是什麼？
quiz.a: Kinetoplast（核旁棒狀構造），Leishmania 有、Histoplasma 無
